objects.name: AP_PurchaseAccView
objects.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[AP_PurchaseAccView]
AS
SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo AS MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID , RefDoc ,
InvAccID AS DebitAccID,  PayAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(SourceAmount) AS SourceAmount, SUM(Amount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, SUM(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AP_PurchaseTbl A INNER JOIN  AP_PurchaseDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE COALESCE(InvAccID,'') <> ''
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo,  CostCenterID, CostID,InvAccID, PayAccID, RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL
-- PB chi phi mua hang
SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo AS MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID , RefDoc ,
InvAccID AS DebitAccID,  CostAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(PurchaseCost)  AS SourceAmount, SUM(PurchaseCost)  AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AP_PurchaseTbl A INNER JOIN  AP_PurchaseDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE PurchaseCost <> 0 AND COALESCE(InvAccID,'') <> ''
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo, CostCenterID, CostID,InvAccID, CostAccID, RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL
-- Phi khac, phi bao ve moi truong, dua vao 15xx
SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo AS MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID , RefDoc ,
InvAccID AS DebitAccID,  TKPhiKhac AS CreditAccID, SUM(PhiKhac)  AS SourceAmount, SUM(PhiKhac)  AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AP_PurchaseTbl A INNER JOIN  AP_PurchaseDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE COALESCE(PhiKhac,0) <> 0 AND COALESCE(TKPhiKhac,'') <> ''
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo, CostCenterID, CostID,InvAccID, TKPhiKhac, RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch


UNION ALL

SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  InvoiceNo, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo AS MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID, RefDoc,
VATAccID AS DebitAccID,  PayAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(VATAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, SUM(VATAmount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AP_PurchaseTbl A INNER JOIN  AP_PurchaseDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE isImport = 0 AND COALESCE(VATAmount,0) <> 0
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo,  CostCenterID, CostID,VATAccID, PayAccID, RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL

SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo AS MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID, RefDoc,
InvAccID AS DebitAccID,  ImportAccID2 AS CreditAccID, SUM(ImportAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, SUM(ImportAmount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AP_PurchaseTbl A INNER JOIN  AP_PurchaseDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE isImport <> 0 AND COALESCE(ImportAmount,0) <> 0
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, Memo,  CostCenterID, CostID,InvAccID, ImportAccID2, RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL

SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo AS MasterMemo,CostCenterID, CostID, RefDoc,
VATAccID AS DebitAccID,  ImportAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(VATAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, SUM(VATAmount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AP_PurchaseTbl A INNER JOIN  AP_PurchaseDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE isImport <> 0 AND COALESCE(VATAmount,0) <> 0
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, Memo,  CostCenterID, CostID,VATAccID, ImportAccID, RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

objects.name: AP_PurchaseAllocateRefdocView
objects.definition:
CREATE View [dbo].[AP_PurchaseAllocateRefdocView]
as
Select  A.RefDoc, DocumentDate, SourceID, SourceName, A.AccountID,  A.AccountID CostAccID, Memo, A.Amount - Coalesce(B.Amount,0) Amount
From (
select DocumentID as RefDoc, DocumentDate, A.SourceID, SourceName, DebitAccID as AccountID,  MasterMemo Memo, sum(Amount) as  Amount
	from vGeneralAcc A
		left join vSourceList B on A.SourceID = B.SourceID
		left join dbo.CF_ChartAccTbl C ON C.AccountID = A.DebitAccID
	where  ( DebitAccID like '15%' OR DebitAccID = '2411' ) AND C.isItem = 0
	group by DocumentID , DocumentDate, A.SourceID, SourceName, DebitAccID ,  MasterMemo

)  A
	Left join (
		Select RefDoc, AccountID,  sum(Amount)  Amount
		from (
			Select RefDoc, AccountID, Amount from AP_PurchaseAllocateTbl
			Union all
			Select RefDoc, CostAccID, Amount from IV_InputRefExpTbl
		) A group by RefDoc, AccountID
	) B on A.RefDoc = B.RefDoc and A.AccountID = B.AccountID
Where A.Amount  - Coalesce(B.Amount,0) <> 0

from AP_ReturnTbl A inner join  AP_ReturnDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where  Coalesce(VATAmount,0) <> 0
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, A.Memo,CostCenterID, CostID, VATAccID, PayAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

union all -- chi phi thue NK

Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , A.Memo, Memo as MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID,RefDoc,
ExpenseAccID as DebitAccID, InvAccID as CreditAccID, sum(ImportAmount) / RateExchange as SourceAmount, sum(ImportAmount) as Amount, Status, ItemID, null , ContractID, DocBatch
from AP_ReturnTbl A inner join  AP_ReturnDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID

objects.name: AR_InvoiceAccView
objects.definition:
CREATE View [dbo].[AR_InvoiceAccView]
as
Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Coalesce(DienGiai,Memo) Memo, Memo MasterMemo, Coalesce(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) CostCenterID, Coalesce(A.CostID, B.CostID) CostID ,RefDoc,
RevAccID AS DebitAccID,  IncomeAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(SourceAmount) AS SourceAmount, SUM(Amount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, SUM(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A INNER JOIN  AR_InvoiceDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status ,COALESCE(DienGiai,Memo), Memo, COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,IncomeAccID, RevAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL

SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,RefDoc,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(VATAccID2,'') <> '' THEN VATAccID2 ELSE RevAccID END AS DebitAccID,
VATAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(VATAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, SUM(VATAmount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A INNER JOIN  AR_InvoiceDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE COALESCE(VATAmount,0) <> 0
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ,
CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo, COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID), VATAccID,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(VATAccID2,'') <> '' THEN VATAccID2 ELSE RevAccID END,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch



UNION ALL
-- Gia Vốn HH
SELECT  A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID,RefDoc,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.Amount,0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(I.ExpenseAccID,B.CostOfSaleAccID ) ELSE B.CostOfSaleAccID END AS DebitAccID,
B.InvAccID AS CreditAccID, 0 AS SourceAmount, SUM(COALESCE(AmountCost,0)) AS Amount, Status, B.ItemID, SUM(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A
		INNER JOIN  AR_InvoiceDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT JOIN  CF_ItemTbl I ON B.ItemID= I.ItemID
WHERE COALESCE(I.IsService,0) = 0 AND COALESCE(B.CostOfSaleAccID,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(B.InvAccID,'') <> ''
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, Memo,
 B.CostCenterID, B.CostID,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.Amount,0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(I.ExpenseAccID,B.CostOfSaleAccID ) ELSE B.CostOfSaleAccID END,
 B.InvAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, B.ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

 /*

 UNION ALL
-- Gia Vốn Dich vu khong co
SELECT  A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID,RefDoc,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.Amount,0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(I.ExpenseAccID,B.CostOfSaleAccID ) ELSE B.CostOfSaleAccID END AS DebitAccID,
B.InvAccID AS CreditAccID, 0 AS SourceAmount, SUM(COALESCE(Amount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) ) AS Amount, Status, B.ItemID, SUM(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A
		INNER JOIN  AR_InvoiceDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT JOIN  CF_ItemTbl I ON B.ItemID= I.ItemID
WHERE COALESCE(I.IsService,0) = 1 AND COALESCE(B.CostOfSaleAccID,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(B.InvAccID,'') <> ''
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END , CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, Memo,
 B.CostCenterID, B.CostID,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.Amount,0) = 0 THEN COALESCE(I.ExpenseAccID,B.CostOfSaleAccID ) ELSE B.CostOfSaleAccID END,
 B.InvAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, B.ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

 */


-- thue xuat khau
UNION ALL

SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo, COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,RefDoc,
IncomeAccID AS DebitAccID, VATAccExID AS CreditAccID,
SUM(ExportAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, SUM(ExportAmount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A INNER JOIN  AR_InvoiceDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE COALESCE(ExportAmount,0) <> 0
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ,
CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo, COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID), VATAccExID,
IncomeAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

-- chiet khau. phai tham chieu vao chinh chung tu nay
UNION ALL

SELECT  A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo MasterMemo,
	COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID) ,A.DocumentID RefDoc,
	B.DiscountAcctID AS DebitAccID, RevAccID AS CreditAccID,
SUM(COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) ) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount,
SUM(COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) ) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_InvoiceTbl A
	INNER JOIN  AR_InvoiceDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE ( COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0)  <> 0 ) AND  COALESCE(DiscountAcctID,'') <> ''
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ObjectID,'') = '' THEN A.ObjectID ELSE B.ObjectID END ,
CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo, COALESCE(A.CostCenterID, B.CostCenterID) , COALESCE(A.CostID, B.CostID), B.DiscountAcctID,
RevAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[AR_ReturnAccView]
AS
SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , A.Memo, Memo MasterMemo,  CostCenterID, CostID,RefDoc,
ReturnAccID AS DebitAccID,  RevAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(SourceAmount) AS SourceAmount, SUM(Amount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, SUM(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_ReturnTbl A INNER JOIN  AR_ReturnDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, A.Memo,CostCenterID, CostID, ReturnAccID, RevAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL

SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , A.Memo, Memo MasterMemo,  CostCenterID, CostID,RefDoc,
RevAccID AS DebitAccID,  DiscountAcctID AS CreditAccID,
SUM( COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) )  AS SourceAmount,
SUM(COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) ) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, SUM(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_ReturnTbl A INNER JOIN  AR_ReturnDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, A.Memo,CostCenterID, CostID,
 DiscountAcctID, RevAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL


SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , A.Memo, Memo MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID,RefDoc,
VATAccID AS DebitAccID, RevAccID AS CreditAccID, SUM(VATAmount) / RateExchange AS SourceAmount, SUM(VATAmount) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_ReturnTbl A INNER JOIN  AR_ReturnDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE  COALESCE(VATAmount,0) <> 0
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate,isLock,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , A.Memo, CostCenterID, CostID,VATAccID, RevAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

UNION ALL
SELECT A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , A.Memo, Memo MasterMemo,  CostCenterID, CostID,RefDoc,
InvAccID AS DebitAccID, CostOfSaleAccID AS CreditAccID, 0 AS SourceAmount, SUM(COALESCE(AmountCost,0)) AS Amount, Status, ItemID, NULL, ContractID, DocBatch
FROM AR_ReturnTbl A INNER JOIN  AR_ReturnDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
WHERE  COALESCE(AmountCost,0) <> 0 AND COALESCE(InvAccID,'') <> ''
GROUP BY A.DocumentID, DocumentDate,isLock,  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, A.Memo,CostCenterID, CostID, CostOfSaleAccID, InvAccID,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

objects.name: CS_PaymentAccView
objects.definition:
CREATE View [dbo].[CS_PaymentAccView]
as
Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange ,
	case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end as Memo, A.Memo MasterMemo , CostCenterID, CostID, RefDoc,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end RefDoc2,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end ObjectID2,
AccountID as DebitAccID,
Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end as CreditAccID,
sum(SourceAmount) as SourceAmount, sum(Amount) as Amount, Status, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch
from CS_PaymentTbl A inner join  CS_PaymentDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where Amount <> 0
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end,A.Memo  ,
	CostCenterID, CostID, AccountID,  Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end ,
	RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end ,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end

union all

Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end , A.Memo MasterMemo , CostCenterID, CostID,RefDoc,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end RefDoc2,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end ObjectID2,
VATAccID as DebitAccID, Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end  as CreditAccID, sum(VATAmount) / RateExchange as SourceAmount, sum(VATAmount) as Amount, Status, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch
from CS_PaymentTbl A inner join  CS_PaymentDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where  Coalesce(VATAmount,0) <> 0
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end,
	CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status, case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end, A.Memo  ,
	CostCenterID, CostID, VATAccID,  Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end ,
RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end ,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end

objects.name: CS_ReceiptAccView
objects.definition:
CREATE View [dbo].[CS_ReceiptAccView]
as
Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,InvoiceNo, Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ObjectID2, CurrencyID, RateExchange , case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end as Memo, A.Memo MasterMemo , CostCenterID, CostID,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end RefDoc,
	RefDoc as RefDoc2,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end ObjectID,
Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end as DebitAccID,  AccountID as CreditAccID, sum(SourceAmount) as SourceAmount, sum(Amount) as Amount, Status, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch
from CS_ReceiptTbl A inner join  CS_ReceiptDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where Amount <> 0
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status,
case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end,  A.Memo  ,CostCenterID, CostID,AccountID,
Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end ,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end ,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end

union all

Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo, Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ObjectID2, CurrencyID, RateExchange , case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end as Memo, A.Memo MasterMemo , CostCenterID, CostID,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end RefDoc,
	RefDoc RefDoc2,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end ObjectID,
Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end as DebitAccID, VATAccID as CreditAccID, sum(VATAmount) / RateExchange as SourceAmount, sum(VATAmount) as Amount, Status, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch
from CS_ReceiptTbl A inner join  CS_ReceiptDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where  Coalesce(VATAmount,0) <> 0
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end , CurrencyID, RateExchange , Status,
	case when Coalesce(B.Memo,'' ) <> '' then  B.Memo else A.Memo end , A.Memo  , CostCenterID, CostID, VATAccID,
Case when Coalesce(DiffAccID,'') = '' then CashAccountID else DiffAccID end ,RefDoc, InvoiceNo, ContractID, BankContractID, CSType, DocBatch,
	Case when Coalesce(RefDoc2,'') = '' then RefDoc else RefDoc2 end,
	Case when Coalesce(ObjectID2,'') = '' then Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  else ObjectID2 end

    A.NgaySinh, A.NamSinh, A.NoiSinh, A.DiaChiThuongTru, A.DiaChiHienNay, A.Email, A.NgayNghiViec,
    A.WorkingGroupName, A.PeoplesName, A.ReligionName, A.BankHolder, A.BankName, A.BankAccountNo,
    A.BankLocation, A.CareerName, A.EducationName, A.HospitalName, A.HonNhan, A.SocialID,
    A.SocialDate, A.FingerData, A.FingerData2, A.NgayThuViec,A.NgayKetThucThuViec, A.SoHopDong, A.LoaiHopDong,
    --A.NgayHopDong, A.NgayHetHopDong,
    A.DungCuLamViec, A.GhiChu, A.PersonStatus, A.SoTheBHYT,
    A.ThoiGianHuongBHYT, A.NoiDangKyBHYT, A.STT, A.Quanly, A.LocationID, A.NguoiLienHe,
    A.MoiQuanHe, A.NguoiLienHeSoDT, A.NgayDuKienTV, A.NgayKetThucBH, A.NgayXuLyCheDo,
    A.TinhTrangXL, A.SoTienTamGiu, A.NgayXuLyCheDo2, A.TinhTrangXL2, A.SoTienTamGiu2,
    A.NgayXuLyCheDo3, A.TinhTrangXL3, A.UserCreate, A.UserUpdate, A.DateUpdate, A.DateCreate,
    A.ChamCong,  A.NewPersonID, A.MaNVChamCong, A.DiaChiTamTru, A.TemporaryResidenceAddress,
    A.Position, A.Nationality,A.isTaiTuyen,A.UserID,A.SoQuyetDinhNghiViec,
    A.IsChamCongTatCa,


    -- Dữ liệu lấy từ APPLY
    B.TenBangCa,
    PGT.LoaiGiayTo,
    PGT.TuNgay,
    PGT.DenNgay,
    HD.NgayCoHieuLuc,
    HD.NgayHetHieuLuc,
    HD.NamLap,
    HD.LoaiHD

FROM dbo.HR_PersonTbl AS A

/* Lấy ca làm việc mới nhất */
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 SC.TenBangCa
    FROM dbo.HR_SapCaNhanVienTbl AS SCNV
    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_SapCaTbl AS SC ON SC.SapCaID = SCNV.SapCaID
    WHERE SCNV.PersonID = A.PersonID
    ORDER BY SC.TuNgay DESC, SC.SapCaID DESC
) AS B

/* Lấy giấy tờ mới nhất */
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 GT.LoaiGiayTo, GT.TuNgay, GT.DenNgay
    FROM dbo.HR_PersonGiayToTbl AS GT
    WHERE GT.PersonID = A.PersonID
    ORDER BY ISNULL(GT.TuNgay, '19000101') DESC, GT.PersonID DESC
) AS PGT

/* Lấy hợp đồng mới nhất */
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 H.NgayCoHieuLuc, H.NgayHetHieuLuc,H.NamLap,H.LoaiHD
    FROM dbo.HR_HopDongTbl AS H
    WHERE H.PersonID = A.PersonID
    ORDER BY ISNULL(H.NgayKyHopDong, '19000101') DESC, H.MaHopDong DESC
) AS HD

CREATE View  [dbo].[IV_AdjustAccView]

as

Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, A.Memo, A.Memo MasterMemo ,DebitAccID, CreditAccID, B.Amount, Status , DocBatch
from IV_AdjustTbl A
	inner join (
		Select DocumentID, AdjustGroup, InvAccID DebitAccID, sum(Amount) as Amount from IV_AdjustDetailTbl where Type = 'N'
		group by DocumentID, AdjustGroup, InvAccID
	) B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
	inner join (
		Select DocumentID, AdjustGroup, InvAccID CreditAccID from IV_AdjustDetailTbl where Type = 'X'

objects.name: IV_InOutAccView
objects.definition:
CREATE View [dbo].[IV_InOutAccView]
as

--  phieu nhap
Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo as MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID ,
InvAccID as DebitAccID,  PayAccID as CreditAccID, sum(SourceAmount) as SourceAmount, sum(Amount) as Amount, Status, ItemID, Sum(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
from IV_InOutTbl A inner join  IV_InOutDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where Coalesce(InvAccID,'') <> ''
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end , CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo,  CostCenterID, CostID,InvAccID, PayAccID, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

union all

Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  InvoiceNo, Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end  ObjectID, CurrencyID, RateExchange , Memo, Memo as MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID,
VATAccID as DebitAccID,  PayAccID as CreditAccID, sum(VATAmount) / RateExchange as SourceAmount, sum(VATAmount) as Amount, Status, ItemID, null, ContractID, DocBatch
from IV_InOutTbl A inner join  IV_InOutDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where Coalesce(VATAmount,0) <> 0
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end , CurrencyID, RateExchange, Status , Memo,  CostCenterID, CostID,VATAccID, PayAccID, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch



--  phieu xuat
union all
Select A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock, InvoiceNo,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ObjectID, 'VND', 1 , Memo, Memo as MasterMemo, CostCenterID, CostID ,
ExpenseAccID as DebitAccID,  InvAccID as CreditAccID, sum(AmountCost) as SourceAmount, sum(AmountCost) as Amount, Status, ItemID, Sum(Quantity) Quantity, ContractID, DocBatch
from IV_InOutTbl A inner join  IV_InOutDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
where Coalesce(InvAccID,'') <> ''
group by A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, isLock,  Case when Coalesce(B.ObjectID,'') = '' then A.ObjectID else B.ObjectID end ,  Status , Memo,  CostCenterID, CostID,InvAccID, ExpenseAccID, InvoiceNo, ItemID, ContractID, DocBatch

objects.name: vCouponIn
objects.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vCouponIn]
AS
-- thu hoi phieu qua tang
-- chon trong Return, Tong hop

SELECT M.Memo AS Dot,  A.CouponSeri, B.TriGia, M.NgayHetHan  , M.ItemID, ItemName
FROM (
	SELECT CouponSeri
	FROM (
		SELECT CouponSeri, 1 AS SL FROM dbo.AR_InvoiceCouponTbl
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CouponSeri, 1 AS SL FROM dbo.IV_OutputCouponTbl  WHERE XuatHuy = 0
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CouponSeri, 1 AS SL FROM dbo.AR_BanHoCouponTbl
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CouponSeri, -1 AS SL FROM dbo.AR_ReturnCouponTbl
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  CouponSeri, -1 AS SL FROM dbo.GJ_EntryCouponTbl
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CouponSeri, -1 AS SL FROM dbo.IV_InputCouponTbl
		UNION ALL
		-- chu y : xuat kho NB  xuat huy
		SELECT CouponSeri, -1 AS SL FROM dbo.IV_OutputCouponTbl  WHERE XuatHuy = 1

	) A GROUP BY CouponSeri HAVING SUM(SL) > 0
) A
	 LEFT  JOIN AR_PhieuGiamGiaDetailTbl B ON A.CouponSeri = B.CouponSeri
	 LEFT  JOIN AR_PhieuGiamGiaTbl M ON B.DocumentID = M.DocumentID
	 LEFT JOIN dbo.CF_ItemTbl X ON M.ItemID = X.ItemID


WHERE A.CouponSeri IS NOT NULL

objects.name: vCouponOut
objects.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vCouponOut]
AS

-- dung de chon xuat
-- tinh ton chua xuat

 SELECT A.Memo AS Dot,  B.CouponSeri , B.TriGia, A.NgayHetHan , A.ItemID, ItemName
 FROM  AR_PhieuGiamGiaTbl A
   INNER JOIN AR_PhieuGiamGiaDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
   INNER JOIN (
			SELECT CouponSeri, SUM(SL)  AS SL
			FROM (
				SELECT CouponSeri, 1 AS SL FROM dbo.AR_PhieuGiamGiaDetailTbl
				UNION ALL
				SELECT CouponSeri, -1 AS SL FROM dbo.AR_InvoiceCouponTbl
				UNION ALL
				SELECT CouponSeri, -1 AS SL FROM dbo.AR_BanHoCouponTbl
				UNION ALL
				SELECT CouponSeri, 1 AS SL FROM dbo.AR_ReturnCouponTbl
				UNION ALL
				SELECT CouponSeri, 1 AS SL FROM dbo.IV_InputCouponTbl
				UNION ALL
				SELECT CouponSeri, -1 AS SL FROM dbo.IV_OutputCouponTbl   -- lay het, xem nhu xuat
			) A GROUP BY CouponSeri HAVING SUM(SL) > 0

	 ) I ON B.CouponSeri = I.CouponSeri

   LEFT JOIN dbo.CF_ItemTbl X ON A.ItemID = X.ItemID

AS

objects.name: vHR_BaoHiemChiTiet_CanhBaoMucDong
objects.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vHR_BaoHiemChiTiet_CanhBaoMucDong]
AS

SELECT
    CT.*,

    PeriodID = BH.PeriodID,
    LoaiBaoHiem = BH.LoaiBaoHiem,
    KeyID = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), BH.PeriodID) + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), BH.LoaiBaoHiem), N''),

    PersonName = P.PersonName,
    BranchID_Person = P.BranchID,
    PhongBan = P.PhongBan,
    PersonStatus = P.PersonStatus,

    MucDongHienTai = CT.MucDong,

    PeriodIDKyTruoc = BHTruoc.PeriodIDKyTruoc,
    DocumentIDKyTruoc = BHTruoc.DocumentIDKyTruoc,
    MucDongKyTruoc = BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc,

    ChenhLechMucDong =
        ISNULL(CT.MucDong, 0) - ISNULL(BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc, 0),

    IsTangMucDong =
        CASE
            WHEN BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc IS NOT NULL
             AND ISNULL(CT.MucDong, 0) > ISNULL(BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc, 0)
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    TrangThaiMucDong =
        CASE
            WHEN BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc IS NULL THEN N'CHƯA CÓ KỲ TRƯỚC'
            WHEN ISNULL(CT.MucDong, 0) > ISNULL(BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc, 0) THEN N'TĂNG MỨC ĐÓNG'
            WHEN ISNULL(CT.MucDong, 0) < ISNULL(BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc, 0) THEN N'GIẢM MỨC ĐÓNG'
            ELSE N'KHÔNG ĐỔI'
        END,

    MauDong =
        CASE
            WHEN BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc IS NOT NULL
             AND ISNULL(CT.MucDong, 0) > ISNULL(BHTruoc.MucDongKyTruoc, 0)
                THEN N'RED'
            ELSE N''
        END

FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl CT

INNER JOIN dbo.HR_BaoHiemTbl BH
    ON BH.DocumentID = CT.DocumentID

LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
    ON P.PersonID = CT.PersonID

OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT TOP 1
        BH2.PeriodID AS PeriodIDKyTruoc,
        BH2.DocumentID AS DocumentIDKyTruoc,
        CT2.MucDong AS MucDongKyTruoc
    FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl CT2
    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_BaoHiemTbl BH2
        ON BH2.DocumentID = CT2.DocumentID
    WHERE CT2.PersonID = CT.PersonID
      AND TRY_CONVERT(INT, BH2.PeriodID) < TRY_CONVERT(INT, BH.PeriodID)
      AND ISNULL(BH2.LoaiBaoHiem, N'') = ISNULL(BH.LoaiBaoHiem, N'')
    ORDER BY
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, BH2.PeriodID) DESC,
        BH2.DocumentID DESC
) BHTruoc;

objects.name: vHR_BaoHiemChiTiet_GanNhat

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vHR_BaoHiemChiTiet_GanNhat]
AS
SELECT *
FROM
(
    SELECT
        D.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY D.PersonID
            ORDER BY M.DocumentDate DESC, M.DocumentID DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl D
    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_BaoHiemTbl M
        ON M.DocumentID = D.DocumentID
) X
WHERE X.RN = 1;

    A.NationName,
    A.Nationality,
    A.NgayVaoLam,
    A.CMND,
    A.CMNDNgayCap,
    A.CMNDNoiCap,
    A.DiaChiThuongTru,
    A.DiaChiHienNay,
    A.DiaChiTamTru,
    A.TemporaryResidenceAddress,
    A.Position,
    PCS.StatusName,

    --A.ChucDanhChuyenMon,

    BHGanNhat.MucDong AS MucDongBH_GanNhat

FROM dbo.HR_HopDongTbl HD
LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl A
    ON HD.PersonID = A.PersonID
LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_ChucDanhTbl CD

(

        BHCT.MucDong
    FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl BHCT
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_BaoHiemTbl BH
        ON BH.DocumentID = BHCT.DocumentID
    WHERE BHCT.PersonID = HD.PersonID
    ORDER BY
        BH.DocumentDate DESC,
        BH.PeriodID DESC
) BHGanNhat

objects.name: vInvoiceItem
objects.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vInvoiceItem]
AS
-- Dung cho bao cao ban hang chi tiet, Tong hop

SELECT 'SI' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, CurrencyID, RateExchange,  A.Memo, InvoiceNo, O.ObjectGroupID,
	O.ZoneID, Z.ZoneName, Z.ZoneGroup , A.ObjectID, O.ObjectName, O.Address,
	COALESCE(A.LocationID, O.LocationID) AS LocationID, LocationName, LocationGroup,
	StoreHouseID, I.ItemGroupID, I.CategoryID, CategoryName, B.ItemID, I.ItemName, B.Lot, B.ExpireDate, B.IncomeAccID, B.InvAccID,
	  L.LotName,    I.Unit, Quantity, UnitPrice, DiscountPercent,
	B.SourceAmount - COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0)  - COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) AS SourceAmount ,
	Amount AS TienHang, DiscountAmount, DiscountAmount2,
	COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0) + COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) AS ChietKhau ,
	 Amount - COALESCE(DiscountAmount,0)  - COALESCE(DiscountAmount2,0) AS  Amount, B.VATID, B.VATPercent, VATAmount, TotalAmount, UnitCost, AmountCost, ContractID, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID, EmployeeID, NV.ObjectName EmployeeName, NV.Address EmployeeAddress

FROM AR_InvoiceTbl  A
		INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ObjectTbl AS O ON A.ObjectID = O.ObjectID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ObjectTbl NV ON A.EmployeeID = NV.ObjectID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LocationTbl LL ON COALESCE(A.LocationID, O.LocationID) = LL.LocationID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_CategoryTbl AS G ON G.CategoryID = I.CategoryID
		LEFT  JOIN dbo.CF_ZoneTbl AS Z ON O.ZoneID = Z.ZoneID

UNION ALL

SELECT 'SS' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, CurrencyID, RateExchange, A.Memo, InvoiceNo, O.ObjectGroupID,
	O.ZoneID, Z.ZoneName, Z.ZoneGroup , A.ObjectID, O.ObjectName, O.Address,  O.LocationID, LocationName, LocationGroup,
	'', I.ItemGroupID, I.CategoryID, CategoryName, B.ItemID, COALESCE(B.memo, I.ItemName) , '', NULL,B.IncomeAccID , I.InvAccID,
	'',    I.Unit, Quantity, UnitPrice, 0 DiscountPercent,
	B.SourceAmount, 0,0,0,0, Amount, B.VATID, B.VATPercent, VATAmount, TotalAmount, 0, 0, ContractID, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID, EmployeeID, NV.ObjectName EmployeeName, NV.Address EmployeeAddress

FROM AR_ServiceTbl  A
		INNER JOIN AR_ServiceDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN dbo.CF_ObjectTbl AS O ON A.ObjectID = O.ObjectID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ObjectTbl NV ON A.EmployeeID = NV.ObjectID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LocationTbl LL ON O.LocationID = LL.LocationID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_CategoryTbl AS G ON G.CategoryID = I.CategoryID
		LEFT  JOIN dbo.CF_ZoneTbl AS Z ON O.ZoneID = Z.ZoneID

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vItemInput]
AS
SELECT    'PI' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, A.DocumentDate, A.InvoiceNo, A.Memo, A.ObjectID, B.InvAccID, PayAccID AS AccountID2,  ImpExpID , B.StoreHouseID,
                      I.CategoryID,  B.Lot, B.ExpireDate, L.LotName, UPPER(B.ItemID) ItemID,  I.ItemName, I.Unit, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID ,
                      B.Quantity, B.Quantity2, B.PROPERTY, B.Property2,  B.UnitPrice,  B.Amount + COALESCE(ImportAmount,0) + COALESCE(PurchaseCost,0) + COALESCE(PhiKhac,0) AS Amount, 0 AS CalCost, 0 AS CalPrice, 0 AS isPacket

FROM         AP_PurchaseTbl  A
		INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
		INNER  JOIN CF_ChartAccTbl AC ON B.InvAccID = AC.AccountID
	WHERE COALESCE(isItem,0) =  1 AND COALESCE(PayAccID,'')  <> '' --and Status <> 3

-- Nhap xuat thang
UNION ALL

SELECT    'IO' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, A.DocumentDate,A.InvoiceNo, A.Memo, A.ObjectID, B.InvAccID, PayAccID AS AccountID2, NULL ImpExpID , B.StoreHouseID,
                      I.CategoryID,  B.Lot, B.ExpireDate, L.LotName, UPPER(B.ItemID) ItemID,  I.ItemName, I.Unit, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID ,
                      B.Quantity, B.Quantity2, B.Property, B.Property2,  B.UnitPrice,  B.Amount AS Amount, 0 AS CalCost, 0 AS CalPrice, 0 AS isPacket

FROM IV_InOutTbl  A
		INNER JOIN IV_InOutDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
		INNER  JOIN CF_ChartAccTbl AC ON B.InvAccID = AC.AccountID

UNION ALL
SELECT    'SR' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, A.DocumentDate, A.InvoiceNo, A.Memo, A.ObjectID, B.InvAccID, RevAccID AS AccountID2, ImpExpID, B.StoreHouseID,
                      I.CategoryID,  B.Lot, B.ExpireDate, L.LotName, UPPER(B.ItemID),  I.ItemName, I.Unit, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID ,
                      B.Quantity,  B.Quantity2, B.Property, B.Property2, B.UnitCost,  AmountCost AS Amount, 0 AS CalCost, 0 AS CalPrice, 0 AS isPacket

FROM AR_ReturnTbl A
		INNER JOIN AR_ReturnDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
		INNER  JOIN CF_ChartAccTbl AC ON B.InvAccID = AC.AccountID
	WHERE COALESCE(isItem,0) =  1 AND COALESCE(RevAccID,'')  <> '' --and Status <> 3

--nhap kho
UNION ALL
SELECT    'IN' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, A.DocumentDate, '', A.Memo, A.ObjectID, B.InvAccID, AccountID2,  InputType, B.StoreHouseID,
                      I.CategoryID,  B.Lot,B.ExpireDate, L.LotName,  UPPER(B.ItemID),  I.ItemName, I.Unit, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID ,
                      B.Quantity, B.Quantity2, B.Property, B.Property2, B.UnitPrice, Amount AS Amount,  CalCost, CalPrice, isPacket

		INNER JOIN IV_InputDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID

		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
		INNER  JOIN CF_ChartAccTbl AC ON B.InvAccID = AC.AccountID
	WHERE COALESCE(isItem,0) =  1 AND COALESCE(AccountID2,'')  <> '' --and Status <> 3

-- chuyen kho
UNION ALL
SELECT    'IT' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, A.DocumentDate, '',  A.Memo, A.ObjectID,
			CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ToInvAccID,'') = '' THEN B.InvAccID ELSE B.ToInvAccID END , B.InvAccID, ImpExpID, ToStoreHouseID AS StoreHouseID,
                      I.CategoryID,  B.Lot, B.ExpireDate,  L.LotName,  UPPER(B.ItemID),  I.ItemName, I.Unit, NULL, NULL ,
                      B.Quantity, B.Quantity2, B.Property, B.Property2, B.UnitPrice,  Amount, 0 AS CalCost, 0 AS CalPrice, 0 AS isPacket

FROM IV_TranferTbl A
		INNER JOIN IV_TranferDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
		INNER  JOIN CF_ChartAccTbl AC ON AC.AccountID = CASE WHEN COALESCE(B.ToInvAccID,'') = '' THEN B.InvAccID ELSE B.ToInvAccID END
WHERE COALESCE(isItem,0) =  1 --and Status <> 3
-- phan ra, lap ghep

		INNER JOIN IV_AdjustDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
	WHERE Type = 'N' --and Status <> 3

	--Chi mua hang truc tiep ko qua cong no
UNION ALL
SELECT    'CP' AS SourceID, A.DocumentID, A.DocumentDate, A.InvoiceNo, A.Memo, A.ObjectID, B.AccountID, CashAccountID, NULL InputType, B.StoreHouseID,
                      I.CategoryID, NULL Lot, NULL, NULL LotName,  UPPER(B.ItemID),  I.ItemName, I.Unit, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID ,
                      B.Quantity, B.Quantity2, NULL, NULL, B.UnitPrice, Amount AS Amount, 0 AS CalCost, 0 AS CalPrice, 0 AS isPacket

		INNER  JOIN CF_ChartAccTbl AC ON B.AccountID = AC.AccountID
	WHERE COALESCE(Ac.isItem,0) =  1  AND COALESCE(I.IsService,0) = 0

objects.name: vItemPurchase
objects.definition:
CREATE View [dbo].[vItemPurchase]
as
SELECT  ItemID, ItemName, I.CategoryID, CategoryName, Unit, UnitFactor, Unit2, IsService, I.VATID, I.InvAccID, I.CostOfSaleAccID,
	I.IncomeAccID, I.ExpenseAccID , VATPercent
,1 as Quantity ,
	( Select Top 1 UnitPrice from AP_PurchaseTbl A
			inner join AP_PurchaseDetailTbl B on A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
			where Coalesce(UnitPrice,0) <> 0 and DocumentDate <= getdate()
			And B.ItemID = I.ItemID
			Order by DocumentDate desc
		) as UnitPrice
	from CF_ItemTbl I
 left join CF_VATTbl V on I.VATID = V.VATID
	left join CF_CategoryTbl C on I.CategoryID = C.CategoryID

	Where IsDisable = 0

objects.name: vItemSales

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vItemSales]
AS
SELECT  ItemID, ItemName, I.CategoryID, CategoryName, Unit, UnitFactor, Unit2, IsService, I.VATID, I.InvAccID, I.CostOfSaleAccID,
	I.IncomeAccID, I.ExpenseAccID , VATPercent
,1 AS Quantity ,
	( SELECT TOP 1 UnitPrice FROM dbo.AR_InvoiceTbl A
			INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceDetailTbl B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
			WHERE COALESCE(UnitPrice,0) <> 0 AND DocumentDate <= GETDATE()
			AND B.ItemID = I.ItemID
			ORDER BY DocumentDate DESC
		) AS UnitPrice
	FROM CF_ItemTbl I
 LEFT JOIN CF_VATTbl V ON I.VATID = V.VATID
	LEFT JOIN CF_CategoryTbl C ON I.CategoryID = C.CategoryID

	WHERE IsDisable = 0

CREATE View [dbo].[vPurchaseItem]
as

-- DUng cho bao cao mua hang chi tiet, Tong hop

SELECT 'PI' as SourceID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, CurrencyID, RateExchange, isImport,  A.Memo, InvoiceNo, O.ObjectGroupID, A.ObjectID, O.ObjectName, O.Address,
	StoreHouseID, I.CategoryID, CategoryName, B.ItemID, I.ItemName, B.Lot, B.InvAccID,
	  L.LotName,    I.Unit, Quantity, UnitPrice,
	B.SourceAmount, Amount, ImportAmount, B.VATID, B.VATPercent, VATAmount, TotalAmount, ContractID, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID

FROM AP_PurchaseTbl  A
		INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_LotTbl AS L ON B.Lot = L.Lot
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ObjectTbl AS O ON A.ObjectID = O.ObjectID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_CategoryTbl AS G ON G.CategoryID = I.CategoryID


union all

SELECT 'PS' as SourceID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, CurrencyID, RateExchange, 0, A.Memo, InvoiceNo, O.ObjectGroupID,  A.ObjectID, O.ObjectName, O.Address,
	'', I.CategoryID, CategoryName, B.ItemID, Coalesce(B.memo, I.ItemName) , '', B.ExpenseAccID ,
	'',    I.Unit, Quantity, UnitPrice,
	B.SourceAmount, Amount, 0, B.VATID, B.VATPercent, VATAmount, TotalAmount, ContractID, B.CostCenterID, B.CostID

FROM AP_ServiceTbl  A
		INNER JOIN AP_ServiceDetailTbl  B ON A.DocumentID = B.DocumentID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_ItemTbl AS I ON B.ItemID = I.ItemID
		LEFT  JOIN dbo.CF_ObjectTbl AS O ON A.ObjectID = O.ObjectID
		LEFT  JOIN CF_CategoryTbl AS G ON G.CategoryID = I.CategoryID

union all

SELECT 'IO' as SourceID, A.DocumentID, DocumentDate, CurrencyID, RateExchange, 0,  A.Memo, InvoiceNo, O.ObjectGroupID, A.ObjectID, O.ObjectName, O.Address,
	StoreHouseID, I.CategoryID, CategoryName, B.ItemID, I.ItemName, B.Lot, B.InvAccID,
	  L.LotName,    I.Unit, Quantity, UnitPrice,

objects.name: API_BangChamCongTongHop
objects.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[API_BangChamCongTongHop]
(
    @Keyword NVARCHAR(200) = '',
    @SortColumn VARCHAR(50) = '',
    @SortDir VARCHAR(10) = '',
    @Data NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Giải mã các tham số lọc từ JSON bộ lọc gửi lên từ Web
    DECLARE @PeriodID VARCHAR(50) = NULL;
    DECLARE @PhongBan NVARCHAR(50) = NULL;

    IF ISNULL(@Data, '') <> '' AND ISJSON(@Data) > 0
    BEGIN
        SET @PeriodID = JSON_VALUE(@Data, '$.PeriodID');
        SET @PhongBan = JSON_VALUE(@Data, '$.PhongBan');
    END

    -- Truy vấn kết hợp dữ liệu bảng chấm công và bảng nhân viên
    SELECT
        t.PeriodID,
        t.PersonID,
        p.PersonName,
        p.PhongBan,
        t.DocumentDate,
        t.SoNgayThang,
        t.SoNgayDiLam,
        t.SoNgayLe,
        t.TangCa,
        t.SoNgayCongTac,
        t.CongPhep,
        t.NghiPhep,
        t.NghiKhongPhep,
        t.GhiChu
    FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl t
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl p ON t.PersonID = p.PersonID
    WHERE
        -- Bộ lọc Kỳ lương (PeriodID)
        (@PeriodID IS NULL OR t.PeriodID = @PeriodID)
        -- Bộ lọc Phòng ban (PhongBan)
        AND (@PhongBan IS NULL OR p.PhongBan = @PhongBan)
        -- Tìm kiếm chung theo Keyword (Mã NV hoặc Tên NV)
        AND (
            @Keyword = ''
            OR t.PersonID LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            OR p.PersonName LIKE N'%' + @Keyword + '%'
        )
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN @SortColumn = 'PeriodID' AND @SortDir = 'DESC' THEN t.PeriodID END DESC,
        CASE WHEN @SortColumn = 'PeriodID' AND @SortDir <> 'DESC' THEN t.PeriodID END ASC,
        CASE WHEN @SortColumn = 'PersonID' AND @SortDir = 'DESC' THEN t.PersonID END DESC,
        CASE WHEN @SortColumn = 'PersonID' AND @SortDir <> 'DESC' THEN t.PersonID END ASC,
        -- Sắp xếp mặc định theo Kỳ lương giảm dần, Mã nhân viên tăng dần
        t.PeriodID DESC, t.PersonID ASC;
END

    SET @PhongBan = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@PhongBan, '')));
    SET @Keyword = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@Keyword, '')));

    -- Nếu kỳ lương trống, tự động lấy kỳ lương mới nhất
    IF @PeriodID = ''

        FROM dbo.SY_Period
        ORDER BY FromDate DESC;

    SELECT

        t.PersonID,

        -- Bộ lọc Phòng ban (PhongBan)
