CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_TimeSheetReportStp]
@FromDate DATETIME ,
@ToDate DATETIME   ,
@BranchID NVARCHAR(50)

--@PhongBan NVARCHAR(50),
--@HanhChanh BIT,
--@CaDem BIT,
--@TangCa BIT

AS



 SELECT P.BranchID, P.PersonID,PersonName, P.PhongBan,
	EventTime AS ThoiGianChamCong

	FROM  X26DIMTUTACACS.dbo.AC_EventTbl A
		LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P ON P.UserID = A.UserID

 WHERE A.EventTime BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
	AND (@BranchID = '' OR BranchID = @BranchID )

objects.name: HR_TimeSheetTH2CNReportStp
objects.definition:
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_TimeSheetTH2CNReportStp]

    @Template VARCHAR(50) = '',
    @PeriodID NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @BranchID1 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @User VARCHAR(50) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. LẤY QUYỀN CHI NHÁNH TỰ ĐỘNG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UserAllowedBranch;
    CREATE TABLE #UserAllowedBranch (BranchID NVARCHAR(100), BranchName NVARCHAR(200))

    INSERT INTO #UserAllowedBranch (BranchID, BranchName)
    EXEC dbo.HR_Branch_GetByUserStp @UserName = @User;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. TẠO DANH SÁCH LỌC CUỐI CÙNG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FinalBranch;
    CREATE TABLE #FinalBranch (BranchID NVARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY);

    IF LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@BranchID1, ''))) <> ''
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #FinalBranch (BranchID)
        SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value))
        FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(REPLACE(@BranchID1, ',', ';')) S
        INNER JOIN #UserAllowedBranch UA ON LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) = UA.BranchID
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(S.value, ''))) <> '';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #FinalBranch (BranchID) SELECT BranchID FROM #UserAllowedBranch;
    END

    DECLARE
        @FromDate DATE,
        @ToDate DATE,
        @MaxDay INT,
        @DayColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'',
        @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ThangTitle1 NVARCHAR(50),
        @ThangTitle2 NVARCHAR(50),
        @i INT = 1;

    SELECT
        @FromDate = FromDate,
        @ToDate = ToDate
    FROM dbo.SY_Period
    WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL RETURN;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- UPDATE Công phép / Không phép / Ngày lễ
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH CTE_NghiPhep AS
    (
        SELECT
            M.PersonID,
            M.StatusID,
            SUM(ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 0)) AS SoNgayNghi
        FROM dbo.HR_NghiPhepTbl M
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_NghiPhepDetailTbl DT
            ON M.DocumentID = DT.DocumentID
        WHERE ISNULL(M.IsXinHuy, 0) = 0
          AND M.PersonID IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE) <= @ToDate
          AND CAST(DT.DenNgay AS DATE) >= @FromDate
        GROUP BY
            M.PersonID,
            M.StatusID
    ),
    CTE_TongNghi AS
    (
        SELECT
            PersonID,
            SUM(CASE WHEN StatusID = 8 THEN SoNgayNghi ELSE 0 END) AS CongPhep,
            SUM(CASE WHEN StatusID <> 8 THEN SoNgayNghi ELSE 0 END) AS NghiKhongPhep
        FROM CTE_NghiPhep
        GROUP BY PersonID
    ),
    CTE_CongLe AS
    (
        SELECT
            TS.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(H.SoCong, 0)) AS SoNgayLe
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
            ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID
        GROUP BY TS.PersonID
    )
    UPDATE TS
    SET
        TS.CongPhep       = ISNULL(NP.CongPhep, 0),
        TS.NghiKhongPhep  = ISNULL(NP.NghiKhongPhep, 0),
        TS.SoNgayLe       = ISNULL(CL.SoNgayLe, 0)
    FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
    LEFT JOIN CTE_TongNghi NP ON NP.PersonID = TS.PersonID
    LEFT JOIN CTE_CongLe CL   ON CL.PersonID = TS.PersonID
    WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BUILD DAY COLUMNS
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @MaxDay = DAY(@ToDate);
    SET @ThangTitle1 = N'THÁNG ' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@FromDate) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
      SET @ThangTitle2 =
    N'Ngày phép đã sử dụng lũy kế đến tháng '
    + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@FromDate) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
    + '/'
    + CAST(YEAR(@FromDate) AS VARCHAR(4));
    WHILE @i <= @MaxDay
    BEGIN
        SET @DayColumns += N',
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN DAY(N.Ngay) = ' + CAST(@i AS NVARCHAR(2)) + N'
                THEN
                 CASE
                        WHEN TS.PersonID = ''VP010'' THEN ''1.0''

                        WHEN H.HolidayDate IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(D.SoCong,0) > 0
                            THEN CAST(H.HolidayID AS NVARCHAR(20)) + '+' + CAST(D.SoCong AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN H.HolidayDate IS NOT NULL
                            THEN CAST(H.HolidayID AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, N.Ngay)+@@DATEFIRST-1)%7 = 0
                             AND ISNULL(D.SoCong,0) > 0
                            THEN CAST(D.SoCong AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, N.Ngay)+@@DATEFIRST-1)%7 = 0
                            THEN ''OFF''

                        WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL
                            THEN ''1.0''

                        WHEN NP.PersonID IS NOT NULL
                            THEN NP.KyHieu

                        WHEN ISNULL(D.SoCong,0) > 0
                            THEN CAST(D.SoCong AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN N.Ngay > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
                            THEN ''''

                        ELSE ''KP''
                    END
                END
        ) AS [' + CAST(@i AS NVARCHAR(2)) + N']';

        SET @i += 1;
    END;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- DYNAMIC REPORT SQL
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @SQL = N'
    ;WITH NgayCTE AS
    (
        SELECT @FromDate AS Ngay
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, Ngay)
        FROM NgayCTE
        WHERE Ngay < @ToDate
    ),

    BungDonNghi AS
    (
        SELECT
            M.PersonID,
            DT.HinhThucNghi,
            M.StatusID,
            DATEADD(DAY, V.number, CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE)) AS Ngay,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY M.PersonID, DT.NghiTuNgay
                ORDER BY V.number
            ) AS NgayThuMayTrongDon,
            ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 1) AS TongSoNgayNghiThuong
        FROM dbo.HR_NghiPhepTbl M
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_NghiPhepDetailTbl DT
            ON M.DocumentID = DT.DocumentID
        INNER JOIN master..spt_values V
            ON V.type = ''P''
           AND V.number < CEILING(ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 1))
        WHERE ISNULL(M.IsXinHuy, 0) = 0
          AND CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE) <= @ToDate
          AND CAST(DT.DenNgay AS DATE) >= @FromDate
    ),

    NghiPhep AS
    (
        SELECT
            B.PersonID,
            B.Ngay,
            ISNULL(B.HinhThucNghi, ''R'') AS HinhThucNghiThucTe,
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN B.NgayThuMayTrongDon <= FLOOR(B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong)
                        THEN 1.00
                    ELSE B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong - FLOOR(B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong)
                END
            AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS SoNgayNghiTrongNgay,
            CASE
                WHEN B.NgayThuMayTrongDon <= FLOOR(B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong)
                    THEN ISNULL(B.HinhThucNghi, ''R'')
                ELSE ISNULL(B.HinhThucNghi, ''R'') + ''1/2''
            END AS KyHieu,
            B.StatusID
        FROM BungDonNghi B
    ),

    LuongKhoan AS
    (
        SELECT
            LK.PersonID,
            MAX(LK.SoTienKhoan) AS SoTienKhoan
        FROM dbo.HR_LuongKhoanTbl LK
        WHERE CAST(LK.TuNgay AS DATE) <= @ToDate
          AND (LK.DenNgay IS NULL OR CAST(LK.DenNgay AS DATE) >= @FromDate)
        GROUP BY LK.PersonID
    ),

    CongDiLamHopLe AS
    (
        SELECT
            D.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(D.SoCong, 0)) AS SoNgayDiLamHopLe
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl D
        WHERE D.PeriodID = @PeriodID
          AND CAST(D.Ngay AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        GROUP BY D.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiCoLuong AS
    (
        SELECT
            NP.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(NP.SoNgayNghiTrongNgay, 0)) AS SoCongNghiCoLuong
        FROM NghiPhep NP
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_HinhThucNghiListTbl HTN
            ON HTN.HinhThucNghi = NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe
        WHERE NP.Ngay BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
          AND ISNULL(HTN.NghiCoLuong, 0) = 1
          AND ISNULL(NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe, '''') NOT IN (''HH'', ''BL'')
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
              WHERE CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = NP.Ngay
          )
        GROUP BY NP.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiHieuHy AS
    (
        SELECT
            NP.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(NP.SoNgayNghiTrongNgay, 0)) AS SoCongHieuHy
        FROM NghiPhep NP
        WHERE NP.Ngay BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
          AND NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe = ''HH''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
              WHERE CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = NP.Ngay
          )
        GROUP BY NP.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiPhepBuLe AS
    (
        SELECT
            NP.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(NP.SoNgayNghiTrongNgay, 0)) AS SoCongBuLe
        FROM NghiPhep NP
        WHERE NP.Ngay BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
          AND NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe = ''BL''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
              WHERE CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = NP.Ngay
          )
        GROUP BY NP.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiKhongPhep AS
    (
        SELECT
            PE.PersonID,
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN NP.PersonID IS NULL
                         AND ISNULL(D.SoCong, 0) = 0
                         AND H.HolidayDate IS NULL
                         AND F.Ngay <= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
                         AND (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, F.Ngay) + @@DATEFIRST - 1) % 7 <> 0
                        THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS SoNgayNghiKhongPhep
        FROM NgayCTE F
        CROSS JOIN
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT PersonID
            FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl
            WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID
        ) PE
        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl D
            ON PE.PersonID = D.PersonID
           AND CAST(D.Ngay AS DATE) = F.Ngay
           AND D.PeriodID = @PeriodID
        LEFT JOIN NghiPhep NP
            ON PE.PersonID = NP.PersonID
           AND NP.Ngay = F.Ngay
        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
            ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = F.Ngay
        GROUP BY PE.PersonID
    ),

    CongLe AS
    (
        SELECT
            TS.PersonID,
            TS.PeriodID,
            SUM(ISNULL(H.SoCong, 0)) AS NgayCongLe
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
            ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID
        GROUP BY TS.PersonID, TS.PeriodID
    ),

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- XẾP THỨ TỰ PHÒNG BAN VÀ TẠO SỐ LA MÃ
    -- Phòng ban có chức danh mang STT nhỏ nhất được xếp trước.
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DanhSachPhongBan AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            P2.PhongBan,
            MIN(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, TL2.STT), 2147483647))
                OVER (PARTITION BY P2.PhongBan) AS STTPhongBan
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS2
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P2
            ON P2.PersonID = TS2.PersonID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_TitleListTbl TL2
            ON LTRIM(RTRIM(P2.ChucDanhChuyenMon)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(TL2.TitleName))
        WHERE TS2.PeriodID = @PeriodID
          AND P2.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM #FinalBranch)
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(P2.PhongBan, N''''))) <> N''''
    ),

    PhongBanXepHang AS
    (
        SELECT
            PhongBan,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                ORDER BY STTPhongBan, PhongBan
            ) AS SoThuTuPhongBan
        FROM DanhSachPhongBan
    ),

    PhongBanHienThi AS
    (
        SELECT
            PhongBan,
            SoThuTuPhongBan,
            CASE
                WHEN SoThuTuPhongBan BETWEEN 1 AND 99 THEN
                    CASE SoThuTuPhongBan / 10
                        WHEN 0 THEN N''''
                        WHEN 1 THEN N''X''
                        WHEN 2 THEN N''XX''
                        WHEN 3 THEN N''XXX''
                        WHEN 4 THEN N''XL''
                        WHEN 5 THEN N''L''
                        WHEN 6 THEN N''LX''
                        WHEN 7 THEN N''LXX''
                        WHEN 8 THEN N''LXXX''
                        WHEN 9 THEN N''XC''
                    END
                    +
                    CASE SoThuTuPhongBan % 10
                        WHEN 0 THEN N''''
                        WHEN 1 THEN N''I''
                        WHEN 2 THEN N''II''
                        WHEN 3 THEN N''III''
                        WHEN 4 THEN N''IV''
                        WHEN 5 THEN N''V''
                        WHEN 6 THEN N''VI''
                        WHEN 7 THEN N''VII''
                        WHEN 8 THEN N''VIII''
                        WHEN 9 THEN N''IX''
                    END
                ELSE CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SoThuTuPhongBan)
            END AS STTPhongBanLaMa
        FROM PhongBanXepHang
    )

    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            ORDER BY
                PB.SoThuTuPhongBan,
                ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, TL.STT), 2147483647),
                TS.PersonID
        ) AS STT,
        PB.STTPhongBanLaMa,
        TS.UserAutoID,
        TS.PersonID,
        P.PersonName AS HoVaTen,
        CASE
            WHEN PB.STTPhongBanLaMa IS NULL THEN UPPER(ISNULL(P.PhongBan, N''''))
            ELSE PB.STTPhongBanLaMa + N''. '' + UPPER(ISNULL(P.PhongBan, N''''))
        END AS PhongBan,
        P.PhongBan AS PhongBanGoc,
        P.ChucDanhChuyenMon,
         N''1<'' + CAST(@MaxDay AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS Test,
        @ThangTitle1 AS ThangTitle,
         @ThangTitle2 AS ThangTitle2,
        TS.DocumentDate,
        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'') THEN @MaxDay
            ELSE TS.SoNgayThang
        END AS SoNgayThang,
        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'') THEN @MaxDay
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(TS.SoNgayThang, 0)
            ELSE ISNULL(CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe, 0)
        END AS SoNgayDiLam,
        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(TS.SoNgayLe, ISNULL(CL.NgayCongLe, 0))
        END AS NgayCongLe,
        TS.TangCa,
        TS.SoNgayCongTac,
        TS.CongPhep,
        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
        END AS NghiPhep,
        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CKP.SoNgayNghiKhongPhep, 0)
        END AS NghiKhongPhep,
        TS.PeriodID,
        TS.GhiChu'
        + @DayColumns + N',

        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'') THEN @MaxDay
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(TS.SoNgayThang, 0)
            ELSE ISNULL(CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe, 0)
        END AS [TongNgayDiLam],

        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'') THEN @MaxDay
                 + ISNULL(TS.SoNgayLe, ISNULL(CL.NgayCongLe, 0))
                 + ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(TS.SoNgayThang, 0)
            ELSE
                ISNULL(CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe, 0)
                + ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
                + ISNULL(CBL.SoCongBuLe, 0)
                + ISNULL(TS.SoNgayLe, ISNULL(CL.NgayCongLe, 0))
        END AS TongCong,

        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'') THEN @MaxDay
            ELSE TS.SoNgayThang
        END AS SoNgayCongThang,

        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayConLai, 0) AS PhepConLaiNam,
        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayPhepTet, 0) AS SoNgayPhepTet,
        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgay, 0) AS PhepPhatSinh,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CHH.SoCongHieuHy, 0)
        END AS HieuHi,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CBL.SoCongBuLe, 0)
        END AS PhepBuLe,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
        END AS PhepSuDungTrongThang,

        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayDaSuDung, 0) AS PhepDaDungLuyKe,
        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayConLai, 0) AS TonPhepHienTai,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS IsLuongKhoan,

        ISNULL(LK.SoTienKhoan, 0) AS SoTienKhoan,
        TS.SoGioCong

    FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON TS.PersonID = P.PersonID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_DepartmentListTbl DP
        ON P.PhongBan = DP.PhongBan
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, T.STT) AS STT
        FROM dbo.HR_TitleListTbl T
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(T.TitleName)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(P.ChucDanhChuyenMon))
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, T.STT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, T.STT)
    ) TL
    LEFT JOIN PhongBanHienThi PB
        ON PB.PhongBan = P.PhongBan

    CROSS JOIN NgayCTE N
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl D
        ON TS.PersonID = D.PersonID
       AND CAST(D.Ngay AS DATE) = N.Ngay
       AND D.PeriodID = TS.PeriodID
    LEFT JOIN NghiPhep NP
        ON TS.PersonID = NP.PersonID
       AND NP.Ngay = N.Ngay
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
        ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = N.Ngay



    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonNghiPhepTbl NPYear
        ON TS.PersonID = NPYear.PersonID
       AND NPYear.Nam = YEAR(@FromDate)

    LEFT JOIN CongLe CL
        ON CL.PersonID = TS.PersonID
       AND CL.PeriodID = TS.PeriodID

    LEFT JOIN LuongKhoan LK
        ON LK.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongDiLamHopLe CDL
        ON CDL.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiCoLuong CNL
        ON CNL.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiHieuHy CHH
        ON CHH.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiPhepBuLe CBL
        ON CBL.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiKhongPhep CKP
        ON CKP.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID
      AND P.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM #FinalBranch)

    GROUP BY
 TS.UserAutoID,
        TS.PersonID,
        P.PersonName,
        P.PhongBan,
        P.ChucDanhChuyenMon,
        PB.SoThuTuPhongBan,
        PB.STTPhongBanLaMa,
        TL.STT,
        TS.DocumentDate,
        TS.SoNgayThang,
        TS.SoNgayLe,
        LK.PersonID,
        LK.SoTienKhoan,
        CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe,
        CL.NgayCongLe,
        CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong,
        CHH.SoCongHieuHy,
        CBL.SoCongBuLe,
        CKP.SoNgayNghiKhongPhep,
        TS.TangCa,
        TS.SoNgayCongTac,
        TS.CongPhep,
        TS.PeriodID,
        TS.GhiChu,
        NPYear.SoNgayConLai,
        NPYear.SoNgayPhepTet,
        NPYear.SoNgay,
        NPYear.SoNgayDaSuDung,TS.SoGioCong

    ORDER BY
        PB.SoThuTuPhongBan,
        ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, TL.STT), 2147483647),
        TS.PersonID
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 31);
    ';

    EXEC sp_executesql
        @SQL,
        N'@PeriodID NVARCHAR(50),
       @BranchID1 NVARCHAR(MAX),
          @FromDate DATE,
          @ToDate DATE,
          @ThangTitle1 NVARCHAR(50),
           @ThangTitle2 NVARCHAR(50),
          @MaxDay INT',
        @PeriodID  = @PeriodID,
        @BranchID1  = @BranchID1,
        @FromDate  = @FromDate,
        @ToDate    = @ToDate,
        @ThangTitle1 = @ThangTitle1,
        @ThangTitle2 = @ThangTitle2,
        @MaxDay    = @MaxDay;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_TimeSheetTH2ReportStp]

    @Template VARCHAR(50) = '',
    @PeriodID NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @BranchID1 NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @User VARCHAR(50) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. LẤY QUYỀN CHI NHÁNH TỰ ĐỘNG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UserAllowedBranch;
    CREATE TABLE #UserAllowedBranch (BranchID NVARCHAR(100), BranchName NVARCHAR(200))

    INSERT INTO #UserAllowedBranch (BranchID, BranchName)
    EXEC dbo.HR_Branch_GetByUserStp @UserName = @User;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. TẠO DANH SÁCH LỌC CUỐI CÙNG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FinalBranch;
    CREATE TABLE #FinalBranch (BranchID NVARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY);

    IF LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@BranchID1, ''))) <> ''
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #FinalBranch (BranchID)
        SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value))
        FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(REPLACE(@BranchID1, ',', ';')) S
        INNER JOIN #UserAllowedBranch UA ON LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) = UA.BranchID
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(S.value, ''))) <> '';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #FinalBranch (BranchID) SELECT BranchID FROM #UserAllowedBranch;
    END

    DECLARE
        @FromDate DATE,
        @ToDate DATE,
        @MaxDay INT,
        @DayColumns NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'',
        @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ThangTitle1 NVARCHAR(100),
        @ThangTitle2 NVARCHAR(100),
        @i INT = 1;

    SELECT
        @FromDate = FromDate,
        @ToDate = ToDate
    FROM dbo.SY_Period
    WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL RETURN;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- UPDATE Công phép / Không phép / Ngày lễ
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH CTE_NghiPhep AS
    (
        SELECT
            M.PersonID,
            M.StatusID,
            SUM(ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 0)) AS SoNgayNghi
        FROM dbo.HR_NghiPhepTbl M
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_NghiPhepDetailTbl DT
            ON M.DocumentID = DT.DocumentID
        WHERE ISNULL(M.IsXinHuy, 0) = 0
          AND M.PersonID IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE) <= @ToDate
          AND CAST(DT.DenNgay AS DATE) >= @FromDate
        GROUP BY
            M.PersonID,
            M.StatusID
    ),
    CTE_TongNghi AS
    (
        SELECT
            PersonID,
            SUM(CASE WHEN StatusID = 8 THEN SoNgayNghi ELSE 0 END) AS CongPhep,
            SUM(CASE WHEN StatusID <> 8 THEN SoNgayNghi ELSE 0 END) AS NghiKhongPhep
        FROM CTE_NghiPhep
        GROUP BY PersonID
    ),
    CTE_CongLe AS
    (
        SELECT
            TS.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(H.SoCong, 0)) AS SoNgayLe
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
            ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID
        GROUP BY TS.PersonID
    )
    UPDATE TS
    SET
        TS.CongPhep       = ISNULL(NP.CongPhep, 0),
        TS.NghiKhongPhep  = ISNULL(NP.NghiKhongPhep, 0),
        TS.SoNgayLe       = ISNULL(CL.SoNgayLe, 0)
    FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
    LEFT JOIN CTE_TongNghi NP ON NP.PersonID = TS.PersonID
    LEFT JOIN CTE_CongLe CL   ON CL.PersonID = TS.PersonID
    WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BUILD DAY COLUMNS
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @MaxDay = DAY(@ToDate);
    SET @ThangTitle1 =
        N'THÁNG ' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@FromDate) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2);

    SET @ThangTitle2 =
        N'Ngày phép đã sử dụng lũy kế đến tháng '
        + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@FromDate) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
        + '/'
        + CAST(YEAR(@FromDate) AS VARCHAR(4));

    WHILE @i <= @MaxDay
    BEGIN
        SET @DayColumns += N',
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN DAY(N.Ngay) = ' + CAST(@i AS NVARCHAR(2)) + N'
                THEN
                 CASE
                        WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP010'' ,''HH003'',''VP016'')THEN ''1.0''

                        WHEN H.HolidayDate IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(D.SoCong,0) > 0
                            THEN CAST(H.HolidayID AS NVARCHAR(20)) + '+' + CAST(D.SoCong AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN H.HolidayDate IS NOT NULL
                            THEN CAST(H.HolidayID AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, N.Ngay)+@@DATEFIRST-1)%7 = 0
                             AND ISNULL(D.SoCong,0) > 0
                            THEN CAST(D.SoCong AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, N.Ngay)+@@DATEFIRST-1)%7 = 0
                            THEN ''OFF''

                        WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL
                            THEN ''1.0''

                        WHEN NP.PersonID IS NOT NULL
                            THEN NP.KyHieu

                        WHEN ISNULL(D.SoCong,0) > 0
                            THEN CAST(D.SoCong AS NVARCHAR(20))

                        WHEN N.Ngay > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
                            THEN ''''

                        ELSE ''KP''
                    END
                END
        ) AS [' + CAST(@i AS NVARCHAR(2)) + N']';

        SET @i += 1;
    END;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- DYNAMIC REPORT SQL
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @SQL = N'
    ;WITH NgayCTE AS
    (
        SELECT @FromDate AS Ngay
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, Ngay)
        FROM NgayCTE
        WHERE Ngay < @ToDate
    ),

    BungDonNghi AS
    (
        SELECT
            M.PersonID,
            DT.HinhThucNghi,
            M.StatusID,
            DATEADD(DAY, V.number, CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE)) AS Ngay,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY M.PersonID, DT.NghiTuNgay
                ORDER BY V.number
            ) AS NgayThuMayTrongDon,
            ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 1) AS TongSoNgayNghiThuong
        FROM dbo.HR_NghiPhepTbl M
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_NghiPhepDetailTbl DT
            ON M.DocumentID = DT.DocumentID
        INNER JOIN master..spt_values V
            ON V.type = ''P''
           AND V.number < CEILING(ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 1))
        WHERE ISNULL(M.IsXinHuy, 0) = 0
          AND CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE) <= @ToDate
          AND CAST(DT.DenNgay AS DATE) >= @FromDate
    ),

    NghiPhep AS
    (
        SELECT
            B.PersonID,
            B.Ngay,
            ISNULL(B.HinhThucNghi, ''R'') AS HinhThucNghiThucTe,
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN B.NgayThuMayTrongDon <= FLOOR(B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong)
                        THEN 1.00
                    ELSE B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong - FLOOR(B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong)
                END
            AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS SoNgayNghiTrongNgay,
            CASE
                WHEN B.NgayThuMayTrongDon <= FLOOR(B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong)
                    THEN ISNULL(B.HinhThucNghi, ''R'')
                ELSE ISNULL(B.HinhThucNghi, ''R'') + ''1/2''
            END AS KyHieu,
            B.StatusID
        FROM BungDonNghi B
    ),

    LuongKhoan AS
    (
        SELECT
            LK.PersonID,
            MAX(LK.SoTienKhoan) AS SoTienKhoan
        FROM dbo.HR_LuongKhoanTbl LK
        WHERE CAST(LK.TuNgay AS DATE) <= @ToDate
          AND (LK.DenNgay IS NULL OR CAST(LK.DenNgay AS DATE) >= @FromDate)
        GROUP BY LK.PersonID
    ),

    CongDiLamHopLe AS
    (
        SELECT
      D.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(D.SoCong, 0)) AS SoNgayDiLamHopLe
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl D
        WHERE D.PeriodID = @PeriodID
          AND CAST(D.Ngay AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        GROUP BY D.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiCoLuong AS
    (
        SELECT
            NP.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(NP.SoNgayNghiTrongNgay, 0)) AS SoCongNghiCoLuong
        FROM NghiPhep NP
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_HinhThucNghiListTbl HTN
            ON HTN.HinhThucNghi = NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe
        WHERE NP.Ngay BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
          AND ISNULL(HTN.NghiCoLuong, 0) = 1
          AND ISNULL(NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe, '''') NOT IN (''HH'', ''BL'')
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
              WHERE CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = NP.Ngay
          )
        GROUP BY NP.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiHieuHy AS
    (
        SELECT
            NP.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(NP.SoNgayNghiTrongNgay, 0)) AS SoCongHieuHy
        FROM NghiPhep NP
        WHERE NP.Ngay BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
          AND NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe = ''HH''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
              WHERE CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = NP.Ngay
          )
        GROUP BY NP.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiPhepBuLe AS
    (
        SELECT
            NP.PersonID,
            SUM(ISNULL(NP.SoNgayNghiTrongNgay, 0)) AS SoCongBuLe
        FROM NghiPhep NP
        WHERE NP.Ngay BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
          AND NP.HinhThucNghiThucTe = ''BL''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
              WHERE CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = NP.Ngay
          )
        GROUP BY NP.PersonID
    ),

    CongNghiKhongPhep AS
    (
        SELECT
            PE.PersonID,
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN NP.PersonID IS NULL
                         AND ISNULL(D.SoCong, 0) = 0
                         AND H.HolidayDate IS NULL
                         AND F.Ngay <= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
                         AND (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, F.Ngay) + @@DATEFIRST - 1) % 7 <> 0
                        THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS SoNgayNghiKhongPhep
        FROM NgayCTE F
        CROSS JOIN
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT PersonID
            FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl
            WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID
        ) PE
        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl D
            ON PE.PersonID = D.PersonID
           AND CAST(D.Ngay AS DATE) = F.Ngay
           AND D.PeriodID = @PeriodID
        LEFT JOIN NghiPhep NP
            ON PE.PersonID = NP.PersonID
           AND NP.Ngay = F.Ngay
        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
            ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = F.Ngay
        GROUP BY PE.PersonID
    ),

    CongLe AS
    (
        SELECT
            TS.PersonID,
            TS.PeriodID,
            SUM(ISNULL(H.SoCong, 0)) AS NgayCongLe
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
            ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID
        GROUP BY TS.PersonID, TS.PeriodID
    ),

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- XẾP THỨ TỰ PHÒNG BAN VÀ TẠO SỐ LA MÃ
    -- Phòng ban có chức danh mang STT nhỏ nhất được xếp trước.
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DanhSachPhongBan AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            P2.PhongBan,
            MIN(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, TL2.STT), 2147483647))
                OVER (PARTITION BY P2.PhongBan) AS STTPhongBan
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS2
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P2
            ON P2.PersonID = TS2.PersonID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_TitleListTbl TL2
            ON LTRIM(RTRIM(P2.ChucDanhChuyenMon)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(TL2.TitleName))
        WHERE TS2.PeriodID = @PeriodID
          AND P2.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM #FinalBranch)
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(P2.PhongBan, N''''))) <> N''''
    ),

    PhongBanXepHang AS
    (
        SELECT
            PhongBan,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                ORDER BY STTPhongBan, PhongBan
            ) AS SoThuTuPhongBan
        FROM DanhSachPhongBan
    ),

    PhongBanHienThi AS
    (
        SELECT
            PhongBan,
            SoThuTuPhongBan,
            CASE
                WHEN SoThuTuPhongBan BETWEEN 1 AND 99 THEN
                    CASE SoThuTuPhongBan / 10
                        WHEN 0 THEN N''''
                        WHEN 1 THEN N''X''
                        WHEN 2 THEN N''XX''
                        WHEN 3 THEN N''XXX''
                        WHEN 4 THEN N''XL''
                        WHEN 5 THEN N''L''
                        WHEN 6 THEN N''LX''
                        WHEN 7 THEN N''LXX''
                        WHEN 8 THEN N''LXXX''
                        WHEN 9 THEN N''XC''
                    END
                    +
                    CASE SoThuTuPhongBan % 10
                        WHEN 0 THEN N''''
                        WHEN 1 THEN N''I''
                        WHEN 2 THEN N''II''
                        WHEN 3 THEN N''III''
                        WHEN 4 THEN N''IV''
                        WHEN 5 THEN N''V''
                        WHEN 6 THEN N''VI''
                        WHEN 7 THEN N''VII''
                        WHEN 8 THEN N''VIII''
                        WHEN 9 THEN N''IX''
                    END
                ELSE CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), SoThuTuPhongBan)
            END AS STTPhongBanLaMa
        FROM PhongBanXepHang
    )

    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            ORDER BY
                PB.SoThuTuPhongBan,
                ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, TL.STT), 2147483647),
                TS.PersonID
        ) AS STT,
        PB.STTPhongBanLaMa,
        TS.UserAutoID,
        TS.PersonID,
        P.PersonName AS HoVaTen,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%NAM VINH%''
                    THEN N''IJ2456J_701''
                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%THANH ĐA GOLD%''
                  OR UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%THANH ĐA%''
                    THEN N''IZ7434L''
                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%HOÀNG HẢI%''
                  OR UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%HOANG HAI%''
                    THEN N''IJ2719J''
                ELSE N''IC0058''
            END
        ) AS MaDonVi,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%NAM VINH%''
                    THEN N''CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN XÂY DỰNG - THƯƠNG MẠI & ĐẦU TƯ NAM VINH''
                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%THANHDA%''
                  OR UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%THANH ĐA%''
                    THEN N''CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN THANH ĐA GOLD''
                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%HOÀNG HẢI%''
                  OR UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%HOANG HAI%''
                    THEN N''CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN THƯƠNG MẠI DỊCH VỤ HOÀNG HẢI''
                ELSE N''CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN THƯƠNG MẠI DỊCH VỤ DIM TU TAC''
            END
        ) AS TenDonVi,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%NAM VINH%''
                    THEN N''FF12B Ba Vì Cư xá Bắc Hải, Phường Hòa Hưng, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam''

                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%THANH ĐA%''
                  OR UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%THANHDA%''
                    THEN N''428 Bình Quới, Phường Bình Quới, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam''

                WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%HOÀNG HẢI%''
                  OR UPPER(ISNULL(DV.BranchName, N'''')) LIKE N''%HOANG HAI%''
                    THEN N''FF12B Ba Vì, Phường Hòa Hưng, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam''

                ELSE N''FF 12A Ba Vì, Phường Hòa Hưng, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh''
            END
        ) AS DiaChi,
        CASE
            WHEN PB.STTPhongBanLaMa IS NULL THEN UPPER(ISNULL(P.PhongBan, N''''))
            ELSE PB.STTPhongBanLaMa + N''. '' + UPPER(ISNULL(P.PhongBan, N''''))
        END AS PhongBan,
        P.PhongBan AS PhongBanGoc,
        P.ChucDanhChuyenMon,
         N''1<'' + CAST(@MaxDay AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS Test,
        @ThangTitle1 AS ThangTitle,
         @ThangTitle2 AS ThangTitle2,
        TS.DocumentDate,
        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'',''HH003'') THEN @MaxDay
            ELSE TS.SoNgayThang
        END AS SoNgayThang,
        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'',''HH003'') THEN @MaxDay
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(TS.SoNgayThang, 0)
            ELSE ISNULL(CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe, 0)
        END AS SoNgayDiLam,
        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(TS.SoNgayLe, ISNULL(CL.NgayCongLe, 0))
        END AS NgayCongLe,
        TS.TangCa,
        TS.SoNgayCongTac,
        TS.CongPhep,
        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
        END AS NghiPhep,
        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CKP.SoNgayNghiKhongPhep, 0)
        END AS NghiKhongPhep,
        TS.PeriodID,
        TS.GhiChu'
        + @DayColumns + N',

        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'',''HH003'',''HH003'') THEN @MaxDay
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(TS.SoNgayThang, 0)
            ELSE ISNULL(CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe, 0)
        END AS [TongNgayDiLam],

        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'',''HH003'',''HH003'') THEN @MaxDay
                 + ISNULL(TS.SoNgayLe, ISNULL(CL.NgayCongLe, 0))
                 + ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(TS.SoNgayThang, 0)
            ELSE
                ISNULL(CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe, 0)
                + ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
                + ISNULL(CBL.SoCongBuLe, 0)
                + ISNULL(TS.SoNgayLe, ISNULL(CL.NgayCongLe, 0))
        END AS TongCong,

        CASE
            WHEN TS.PersonID IN (''VP016'', ''VP010'',''HH003'',''HH003'') THEN @MaxDay
            ELSE TS.SoNgayThang
        END AS SoNgayCongThang,

        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayConLai, 0) AS PhepConLaiNam,
        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayPhepTet, 0) AS SoNgayPhepTet,
        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgay, 0) AS PhepPhatSinh,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CHH.SoCongHieuHy, 0)
        END AS HieuHi,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CBL.SoCongBuLe, 0)
        END AS PhepBuLe,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ISNULL(CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong, 0)
        END AS PhepSuDungTrongThang,

        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayDaSuDung, 0) AS PhepDaDungLuyKe,
        ISNULL(NPYear.SoNgayConLai, 0) AS TonPhepHienTai,

        CASE
            WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS IsLuongKhoan,

        ISNULL(LK.SoTienKhoan, 0) AS SoTienKhoan,
        TS.SoGioCong

    FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON TS.PersonID = P.PersonID
    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
           BranchID,
            MAX(BranchName) AS BranchName
 FROM #UserAllowedBranch
        GROUP BY BranchID
    ) DV
        ON DV.BranchID = P.BranchID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_DepartmentListTbl DP
        ON P.PhongBan = DP.PhongBan
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, T.STT) AS STT
        FROM dbo.HR_TitleListTbl T
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(T.TitleName)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(P.ChucDanhChuyenMon))
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, T.STT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, T.STT)
    ) TL
    LEFT JOIN PhongBanHienThi PB
        ON PB.PhongBan = P.PhongBan

    CROSS JOIN NgayCTE N
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl D
        ON TS.PersonID = D.PersonID
       AND CAST(D.Ngay AS DATE) = N.Ngay
       AND D.PeriodID = TS.PeriodID
    LEFT JOIN NghiPhep NP
        ON TS.PersonID = NP.PersonID
       AND NP.Ngay = N.Ngay
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_HolidayTbl H
        ON CAST(H.HolidayDate AS DATE) = N.Ngay



    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonNghiPhepTbl NPYear
        ON TS.PersonID = NPYear.PersonID
       AND NPYear.Nam = YEAR(@FromDate)

    LEFT JOIN CongLe CL
        ON CL.PersonID = TS.PersonID
       AND CL.PeriodID = TS.PeriodID

    LEFT JOIN LuongKhoan LK
        ON LK.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongDiLamHopLe CDL
        ON CDL.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiCoLuong CNL
        ON CNL.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiHieuHy CHH
        ON CHH.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiPhepBuLe CBL
        ON CBL.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    LEFT JOIN CongNghiKhongPhep CKP
        ON CKP.PersonID = TS.PersonID

    WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID
      AND P.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM #FinalBranch)

    GROUP BY
 TS.UserAutoID,
        TS.PersonID,
        P.PersonName,
        P.PhongBan,
        P.ChucDanhChuyenMon,
        PB.SoThuTuPhongBan,
        PB.STTPhongBanLaMa,

        TL.STT,
        TS.DocumentDate,
        TS.SoNgayThang,
        TS.SoNgayLe,
        LK.PersonID,
        LK.SoTienKhoan,
        CDL.SoNgayDiLamHopLe,
        CL.NgayCongLe,
        CNL.SoCongNghiCoLuong,
        CHH.SoCongHieuHy,
        CBL.SoCongBuLe,
        CKP.SoNgayNghiKhongPhep,
        TS.TangCa,
        TS.SoNgayCongTac,
        TS.CongPhep,
        TS.PeriodID,
        TS.GhiChu,
        NPYear.SoNgayConLai,
        NPYear.SoNgayPhepTet,
        NPYear.SoNgay,
        NPYear.SoNgayDaSuDung,TS.SoGioCong

    ORDER BY
        PB.SoThuTuPhongBan,
        ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, TL.STT), 2147483647),
        TS.PersonID
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 31);
    ';

    EXEC sp_executesql
        @SQL,
        N'@PeriodID NVARCHAR(50),
       @BranchID1 NVARCHAR(MAX),
          @FromDate DATE,
          @ToDate DATE,
          @ThangTitle1 NVARCHAR(100),
          @ThangTitle2 NVARCHAR(100),
          @MaxDay INT',
        @PeriodID  = @PeriodID,
        @BranchID1  = @BranchID1,
        @FromDate  = @FromDate,
        @ToDate    = @ToDate,
        @ThangTitle1 = @ThangTitle1,
        @ThangTitle2 = @ThangTitle2,
        @MaxDay    = @MaxDay;

END

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_TimeSheetTHReportStp]
@PeriodID NVARCHAR(50) = '',
@BranchID NVARCHAR(50)

--@PhongBan NVARCHAR(50),
--@HanhChanh BIT,
--@CaDem BIT,
--@TangCa BIT
AS
BEGIN
set nocount on
    IF @PeriodID = '' SET @PeriodID = NULL
    IF @BranchID = '' SET @BranchID = NULL
SELECT
    P.BranchID,
    TS.PersonID,
    P.PersonName,
    P.PhongBan,
    TS.DocumentDate AS Ngay,
    NULL AS ThoiGianVao,
    NULL AS ThoiGianRa,
    '' AS GioVao,
    '' AS GioRa,
    0 AS SoGio,
    0 AS SoPhut
FROM HR_TimeSheetTbl TS
LEFT JOIN HR_PersonTbl P
    ON TS.PersonID = P.PersonID
WHERE
    (@PeriodID IS NULL OR TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID)
    AND (@BranchID IS NULL OR P.BranchID = @BranchID)
End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_Update_Permission]   AS
  DELETE FROM HR_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE COALESCE(MenuID,'') = ''
  DELETE FROM HR_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE MenuID IN ( SELECT  COALESCE(MenuID,'') FROM  HR_Menu  WHERE  COALESCE(FormName,'')  = '' )
  DELETE FROM HR_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE UserGroupID NOT  IN ( SELECT  UserGroupID FROM  SY_UserGroup)
  DELETE FROM HR_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE MenuID NOT  IN ( SELECT  MenuID FROM  HR_Menu )

  INSERT INTO HR_UserGroupPermisstion (  UserGroupID , MenuID , IsRun , IsAdd , IsUpdate , IsDelete , isManager , isAdmin  )
  SELECT UserGroupID,  MenuID , 1,0,0,0,0,0
  FROM (
      SELECT UserGroupID,  MenuID  FROM SY_UserGroup, HR_Menu WHERE  COALESCE(FormName,'')  <> ''
    ) A	LEFT JOIN  ( SELECT DISTINCT UserGroupID + MenuID AS Key01 FROM HR_UserGroupPermisstion ) B ON A.UserGroupID +  A.MenuID   = B.Key01
   WHERE B.Key01 IS NULL

  DELETE FROM HR_UserPermisstion WHERE COALESCE(MenuID,'') = ''
  DELETE FROM HR_UserPermisstion WHERE MenuID IN ( SELECT  COALESCE(MenuID,'') FROM  HR_Menu  WHERE  COALESCE(FormName,'')  = '' )
  DELETE FROM HR_UserPermisstion WHERE UserName NOT  IN ( SELECT  UserName FROM  SY_User )
  DELETE FROM HR_UserPermisstion WHERE MenuID NOT  IN ( SELECT  MenuID FROM  HR_Menu )

  INSERT INTO HR_UserPermisstion (  UserName , MenuID , IsRun , IsAdd , IsUpdate , IsDelete , isManager , isAdmin  )

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_UpdateDshBrdStp]
    @User VARCHAR(50),
    @Recal INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @ToDate DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);
    DECLARE @FromMonth DATE;
    DECLARE @ToMonth DATE;
    DECLARE @BranchID NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @IsAllBranch BIT = 0;

    SET @FromMonth = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ToDate), MONTH(@ToDate), 1);
    SET @ToMonth   = DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @FromMonth);

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0. LẤY DANH SÁCH CHI NHÁNH ĐƯỢC GÁN CHO USER
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        @BranchID = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(BranchID)), '')
    FROM dbo.SY_User
    WHERE UserName = @User;

    /*
        Nếu BranchID của user đang NULL hoặc rỗng:
        @IsAllBranch = 1: được xem toàn bộ dữ liệu.

        Nếu muốn user không được gán BranchID thì không thấy dữ liệu,
        đổi dòng dưới thành:
        SET @IsAllBranch = 0;
    */
    SET @IsAllBranch =
        CASE
            WHEN @BranchID IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END;

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#UserBranch') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #UserBranch;

    CREATE TABLE #UserBranch
    (
        BranchID VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );

    IF @BranchID IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #UserBranch (BranchID)
        SELECT DISTINCT
            LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BranchID, ',')
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) <> '';
    END;
	/*

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. NHÂN VIÊN ĐI LÀM TRONG NGÀY
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        0 AS sysName_DiLamTrongNgay,
        ISNULL(P.BranchID, '') AS GroupName,
        P.PersonName,
        1 AS SL,
        MIN(A.ThoiGianVao) AS ThoiGianVao,
        0 AS sysHeight2X,
        0 AS sysHeightFull
    FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl A
    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = A.PersonID
   -- LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_DepartmentListTbl De        ON De.PhongBan = P.PhongBan
    WHERE A.ThoiGianVao >= CAST(@ToDate AS DATETIME)
      AND A.ThoiGianVao < DATEADD(HOUR, 29, CAST(@ToDate AS DATETIME))
      AND
      (
          @IsAllBranch = 1
          OR EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM #UserBranch UB
              WHERE UB.BranchID = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(P.BranchID, '')))
          )
      )
    GROUP BY
        P.PhongBan,
       P.BranchID,
        P.PersonName,
        A.PersonID;



    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. SỐ NGÀY ĐI LÀM TRONG THÁNG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        0 AS sysName_DiLamTrongThang,
        ISNULL(P.BranchID, '') AS GroupName,
        P.PersonName,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(A.ThoiGianVao AS DATE)) AS SL,
        0 AS sysHeight2X,
        0 AS sysHeightFull
    FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl A
    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = A.PersonID
   -- LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_DepartmentListTbl De        ON De.PhongBan = P.PhongBan
    WHERE A.ThoiGianVao >= @FromMonth
      AND A.ThoiGianVao < @ToMonth
      AND
      (
          @IsAllBranch = 1
          OR EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM #UserBranch UB
              WHERE UB.BranchID = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(P.BranchID, '')))
          )
      )
    GROUP BY
        P.PhongBan,
       P.BranchID,
        P.PersonName,
        A.PersonID;
		*/
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. TẠO BẢNG TẠM GOM CÁC HỒ SƠ CÓ NGÀY HẾT HẠN
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HoSoHetHan') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #HoSoHetHan;

    CREATE TABLE #HoSoHetHan
    (
        DocumentID VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        PersonID   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        LoaiHoSo   NVARCHAR(250) NOT NULL,
        NgayHetHan DATE NOT NULL
    );

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3.1. HỢP ĐỒNG LAO ĐỘNG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO #HoSoHetHan
    (
        DocumentID,
        PersonID,
        LoaiHoSo,
        NgayHetHan
    )
    SELECT
        CAST(HD.MaHopDong AS VARCHAR(100)),
        HD.PersonID,
        N'Hợp đồng lao động',
        CAST(HD.NgayHetHieuLuc AS DATE)
    FROM dbo.HR_HopDongTbl HD
    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = HD.PersonID
    WHERE HD.NgayHetHieuLuc IS NOT NULL
      AND ISNULL(HD.PersonID, '') <> ''
      AND
      (
          @IsAllBranch = 1
          OR EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM #UserBranch UB
              WHERE UB.BranchID = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(P.BranchID, '')))
          )
      );

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3.2. GIẤY PHÉP LAO ĐỘNG, VISA, THẺ TẠM TRÚ
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO #HoSoHetHan
    (
        DocumentID,
        PersonID,
        LoaiHoSo,
        NgayHetHan
    )
    SELECT
        ISNULL(CAST(GT.DocumentID AS VARCHAR(100)), GT.PersonID),
        GT.PersonID,
        GT.LoaiGiayTo,
        CAST(GT.DenNgay AS DATE)
    FROM dbo.HR_PersonGiayToTbl GT
    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = GT.PersonID
    WHERE GT.DenNgay IS NOT NULL
      AND
      (
             GT.LoaiGiayTo LIKE N'%GPLD%'
          OR GT.LoaiGiayTo LIKE N'%giấy phép lao động%'
          OR GT.LoaiGiayTo LIKE N'%Visa%'
          OR GT.LoaiGiayTo LIKE N'%tạm trú%'
      )
      AND
      (
          @IsAllBranch = 1
          OR EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM #UserBranch UB
              WHERE UB.BranchID = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(P.BranchID, '')))
          )
      );




    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. NHẮC GIA HẠN TRONG VÒNG 30 NGÀY
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        0 AS sysName_NhacGiaHan1Thang,
        H.PersonID AS MaNhanVien,
        ISNULL(P.PersonName, '') AS HoTen,
        H.DocumentID AS SoChungTu,
        H.LoaiHoSo,
        H.NgayHetHan,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, @ToDate, H.NgayHetHan) AS SoNgayConLai,
        N'Cần gia hạn ngay!' AS NoiDungCanhBao,
			0 AS sysWidthFull, 0 sysHeight2X

    FROM #HoSoHetHan H
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = H.PersonID
    WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY, @ToDate, H.NgayHetHan) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
    ORDER BY
        H.NgayHetHan,
        P.PersonName;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. NHẮC GIA HẠN TỪ 31 ĐẾN 90 NGÀY
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        0 AS sysName_NhacGiaHan3Thang,
        H.PersonID AS MaNhanVien,
        ISNULL(P.PersonName, '') AS HoTen,
        H.DocumentID AS SoChungTu,
        H.LoaiHoSo,
        H.NgayHetHan,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, @ToDate, H.NgayHetHan) AS SoNgayConLai,
        N'Còn '
            + CAST(DATEDIFF(DAY, @ToDate, H.NgayHetHan) AS NVARCHAR(10))
            + N' ngày.' AS NoiDungCanhBao,
			0 AS sysWidthFull, 0 sysHeight2X
    FROM #HoSoHetHan H
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = H.PersonID
    WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY, @ToDate, H.NgayHetHan) BETWEEN 31 AND 90
    ORDER BY
        H.NgayHetHan,
        P.PersonName;


    DROP TABLE #HoSoHetHan;
    DROP TABLE #UserBranch;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_PhieuLuong]
    @PeriodID VARCHAR(6),
    @PersonID VARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @PhongBan NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT
        -- Thông tin nhân viên
        p.PersonID          AS [Mã NV],
        p.PersonName        AS [Họ tên],
        p.PhongBan          AS [Phòng ban],
        p.PostionName       AS [Chức vụ],
        p.TitleName         AS [Chức danh],
        p.NgayVaoLam        AS [Ngày vào làm],
        p.BankAccountNo     AS [Số tài khoản],
        p.BankName          AS [Ngân hàng],

        -- Ngày công
        b.NgayCongTinhLuong AS [Ngày công chuẩn],
        b.NgayCongThucTe    AS [Ngày công thực tế],
        b.SoNgayNghiPhep    AS [Ngày nghỉ phép],
        b.NgayCong          AS [Tổng ngày công],

        -- Thâm niên
        b.SoNamThamNien     AS [Số năm thâm niên],
        b.LuongThamNien     AS [Lương thâm niên],

        -- Lương cơ bản
        b.LuongCoBan        AS [Lương cơ bản],
        b.TyLeHuongLuong    AS [Tỷ lệ hưởng lương],
        b.ThuNhap           AS [Thu nhập],

        -- KPI
        b.LuongMucTieu      AS [Lương KPI 1],
        b.LuongMucTieu2     AS [Lương KPI 2],
        b.LuongMucTieu3     AS [Lương KPI 3],

        -- Phụ cấp
        b.PhuCapAnTrua      AS [PC ăn trưa],
        b.PhuCapXangXe      AS [PC xăng xe],
        b.PhuCapDienThoai   AS [PC điện thoại],
        b.PhuCapThucTe      AS [PC khác 1],
        b.PhuCapThucTe2     AS [PC khác 2],
        b.PhuCapThucTe3     AS [PC khác 3],

        -- Thưởng
        b.Thuong             AS [Thưởng 1],
        b.Thuong2            AS [Thưởng 2],
        b.Thuong3            AS [Thưởng 3],
        b.TruyLinh           AS [Truy lĩnh],

        -- Tổng thu nhập
        b.TongThuNhap        AS [Tổng thu nhập],

        -- Khấu trừ
        b.Phat               AS [Phạt 1],
        b.Phat2              AS [Phạt 2],
        b.Phat3              AS [Phạt 3],
        b.TruyThu            AS [Truy thu],
        b.KPCongDoan         AS [KP công đoàn],
        b.TamGiu             AS [Tạm giữ],

        -- Tổng khấu trừ (tính)
        ISNULL(b.Phat,0) + ISNULL(b.Phat2,0) + ISNULL(b.Phat3,0)
        + ISNULL(b.TruyThu,0) + ISNULL(b.KPCongDoan,0)
        + ISNULL(b.TamGiu,0) AS [Tổng khấu trừ],

        -- Thực lĩnh
        b.ThucLinh           AS [Thực lĩnh],
        b.GhiChu             AS [Ghi chú],
        b.PeriodID

    FROM HR_BangLuongTbl b
    INNER JOIN HR_PersonTbl p ON b.PersonID = p.PersonID
    WHERE b.PeriodID = @PeriodID
      AND (@PersonID IS NULL OR b.PersonID = @PersonID)
      AND (@PhongBan IS NULL OR p.PhongBan = @PhongBan)
    ORDER BY p.PhongBan, p.PersonName
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[WA_TimeSheetDay_Process_Stp]
    @PeriodID VARCHAR(10),
    @BranchID NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;
    SET DATEFIRST 1; -- Thứ 2 = 1, Thứ 7 = 6, Chủ nhật = 7

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE
            @FromDate DATETIME,
            @ToDate DATETIME;

        SELECT
            @FromDate = FromDate,
            @ToDate = ToDate
        FROM dbo.SY_Period
        WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID;

        IF @FromDate IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT -1 AS code, N'Không tìm thấy kỳ chấm công ' + @PeriodID AS msg;
            RETURN;
        END;

        -- 1. Xoá dữ liệu cũ theo kỳ và chi nhánh
        DELETE T
        FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl T
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
            ON T.PersonID = P.PersonID
        WHERE T.PeriodID = @PeriodID
          AND (@BranchID = '' OR P.BranchID = @BranchID);

        -- 2. Tính toán và chèn dữ liệu chấm công mới
        ;WITH Attendance AS
        (
            SELECT
                LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(A.UserID AS NVARCHAR(50)))) AS UserID_Clean,
                CAST(A.EventTime AS DATE) AS Ngay,
                MIN(A.EventTime) AS GioVao,
                MAX(A.EventTime) AS GioRa
            FROM X26DIMTUTACACS.dbo.AC_EventTbl A
            WHERE A.EventTime >= @FromDate
              AND A.EventTime < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate)
            GROUP BY
                LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(A.UserID AS NVARCHAR(50)))),
                CAST(A.EventTime AS DATE)
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayTbl
        (
            UserAutoID,
            PersonID,
            PeriodID,
            Ngay,
            ThoiGianVao,
            ThoiGianRa,
            SoCong,
            GhiChu,
            LyDo
        )
        SELECT
            P.PersonID + FORMAT(A.Ngay, 'ddMMyyyy') AS UserAutoID,
            P.PersonID,
            @PeriodID AS PeriodID,
            A.Ngay,
            V.ActualVao AS ThoiGianVao,
            V.ActualRa AS ThoiGianRa,

            CASE
                WHEN FinalShift.ShiftID IS NULL THEN 0
                WHEN V.ActualVao IS NULL OR V.ActualRa IS NULL THEN 0
                WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.Ngay) = 7 THEN 0

                -- Làm đủ số phút của ca thì lấy số công khai báo trong HR_ShiftListTbl
                WHEN W.TongPhutLam >= Q.PhutCaQuyDinh
                    THEN ISNULL(SH.SoCong, 1)

                ELSE 0
            END AS SoCong,

            CASE
                WHEN FinalShift.ShiftID IS NULL THEN N'Không có ca'
                WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.Ngay) = 7 THEN N'Chủ nhật'
                WHEN FinalShift.SapCaID IS NOT NULL
                    THEN N'Tính theo sắp ca: ' + ISNULL(SH.ShiftName, FinalShift.ShiftID)
                ELSE
                    N'Tính theo ca tự động: ' + ISNULL(SH.ShiftName, FinalShift.ShiftID)
            END AS GhiChu,

            CASE
                WHEN FinalShift.ShiftID IS NULL
                    THEN N'Không có sắp ca và không có ca tự động'

                WHEN V.ActualVao IS NULL OR V.ActualRa IS NULL
                    THEN N'Không đủ dữ liệu chấm công'

                WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.Ngay) = 7
                    THEN N'Chủ nhật không tính công thường'

                WHEN W.TongPhutLam < Q.PhutCaQuyDinh
                    THEN N'Chưa đủ giờ công. Làm '
                         + CAST(W.TongPhutLam AS NVARCHAR(20))
                         + N' phút / cần '
                         + CAST(Q.PhutCaQuyDinh AS NVARCHAR(20))
                         + N' phút'

                ELSE N'Đủ giờ công'
            END AS LyDo

        FROM Attendance A

        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
            ON LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(P.UserID AS NVARCHAR(50)))) = A.UserID_Clean

        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                CT.SapCaID,
                CT.ShiftID
            FROM dbo.HR_SapCaChiTietTbl CT
            WHERE CT.PersonID = P.PersonID
              AND CAST(CT.NgayLamViec AS DATE) = A.Ngay
            ORDER BY CT.UserAutoID DESC
        ) SCCT

        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                SC.SapCaID,
                CASE DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.Ngay)
                    WHEN 1 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu2
                    WHEN 2 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu3
                    WHEN 3 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu4
                    WHEN 4 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu5
                    WHEN 5 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu6
                    WHEN 6 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu7
                    WHEN 7 THEN SC.ShiftIDChuNhat
             END AS ShiftID
            FROM dbo.HR_SapCaTbl SC
            WHERE SC.SapCaID = SCCT.SapCaID
              AND A.Ngay >= CAST(SC.TuNgay AS DATE)
              AND A.Ngay <= CAST(SC.DenNgay AS DATE)
        ) SCTuSapCaID

        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                SC.SapCaID,
                CASE DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.Ngay)
                    WHEN 1 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu2
                    WHEN 2 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu3
                    WHEN 3 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu4
                    WHEN 4 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu5
                    WHEN 5 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu6
                    WHEN 6 THEN SC.ShiftIDThu7
                    WHEN 7 THEN SC.ShiftIDChuNhat
                END AS ShiftID
            FROM dbo.HR_SapCaChiTietTbl CT
            INNER JOIN dbo.HR_SapCaTbl SC
                ON SC.SapCaID = CT.SapCaID
            WHERE CT.PersonID = P.PersonID
              AND A.Ngay >= CAST(SC.TuNgay AS DATE)
              AND A.Ngay <= CAST(SC.DenNgay AS DATE)
            ORDER BY SC.SapCaID DESC
        ) SCTuLichTuan

        -- Nếu không có sắp ca thì lấy ca tự động trong HR_ShiftListTbl
        -- Thứ 2-6: lấy ca HC tự động
        -- Thứ 7: lấy ca T7_SANG tự động
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                SH2.ShiftID
            FROM dbo.HR_ShiftListTbl SH2
            WHERE ISNULL(SH2.CaTuDong, 0) = 1
              AND (
                    (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.Ngay) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND SH2.ShiftID = 'HC')
                 OR (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.Ngay) = 6 AND SH2.ShiftID = 'T7_SANG')
              )
            ORDER BY SH2.ShiftID
        ) AutoShift

        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                COALESCE
                (
                    SCCT.ShiftID,
                    SCTuSapCaID.ShiftID,
                    SCTuLichTuan.ShiftID,
                    AutoShift.ShiftID
                ) AS ShiftID,

                COALESCE
                (
                    SCCT.SapCaID,
                    SCTuSapCaID.SapCaID,
                    SCTuLichTuan.SapCaID
                ) AS SapCaID
        ) FinalShift

        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_ShiftListTbl SH
            ON SH.ShiftID = FinalShift.ShiftID

        LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_TimeSheetDayEditTbl E
            ON P.PersonID = E.PersonID
           AND A.Ngay = CAST(E.ThoiGianVao AS DATE)

        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                ISNULL(E.ThoiGianVao, A.GioVao) AS ActualVao,
                ISNULL(E.ThoiGianRa, A.GioRa) AS ActualRa
        ) RealTime

        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                RealTime.ActualVao,
                RealTime.ActualRa
        ) V

        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN V.ActualVao IS NULL OR V.ActualRa IS NULL THEN 0
                    WHEN V.ActualRa < V.ActualVao THEN 0
                    ELSE DATEDIFF(MINUTE, V.ActualVao, V.ActualRa)
                END AS TongPhutLam
        ) W

        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN SH.GioBatDau IS NULL OR SH.GioKetThuc IS NULL THEN 0

                    WHEN CAST(SH.GioKetThuc AS TIME) < CAST(SH.GioBatDau AS TIME)
                        THEN DATEDIFF
                        (
                            MINUTE,
                            CAST(SH.GioBatDau AS TIME),
                            CAST(SH.GioKetThuc AS TIME)
                        ) + 1440

                    ELSE DATEDIFF
                    (
                        MINUTE,
                        CAST(SH.GioBatDau AS TIME),
                        CAST(SH.GioKetThuc AS TIME)
                    )
                END AS PhutCaQuyDinh
        ) Q

        WHERE (@BranchID = '' OR P.BranchID = @BranchID);

        SELECT 0 AS code, N'Tạo bảng chấm công thành công cho kỳ ' + @PeriodID + N'!' AS msg;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        SELECT -1 AS code, N'Lỗi tạo bảng chấm công: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE() AS msg;
    END CATCH

    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[WA_Update_Permission]

AS

DELETE FROM WA_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE COALESCE(MenuID,'') = ''

DELETE FROM WA_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE MenuID IN ( SELECT  COALESCE(MenuID,'') FROM  WA_Menu  WHERE  COALESCE(FormName,'')  = '' )

DELETE FROM WA_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE UserGroupID NOT  IN ( SELECT  UserGroupID FROM  SY_UserGroup)

DELETE FROM WA_UserGroupPermisstion WHERE MenuID NOT  IN ( SELECT  MenuID FROM  WA_Menu )


INSERT INTO WA_UserGroupPermisstion (  UserGroupID , MenuID , IsRun , IsAdd , IsUpdate , IsDelete , isManager , isAdmin  )

SELECT UserGroupID,  MenuID , 1,0,0,0,0,0
FROM (
SELECT UserGroupID,  MenuID
FROM SY_UserGroup, WA_Menu
WHERE  COALESCE(FormName,'')  <> ''
) A
	LEFT JOIN  ( SELECT DISTINCT UserGroupID + MenuID AS Key01 FROM WA_UserGroupPermisstion
	) B ON A.UserGroupID +  A.MenuID   = B.Key01

WHERE B.Key01 IS NULL

DELETE FROM WA_UserPermisstion WHERE COALESCE(MenuID,'') = ''

DELETE FROM WA_UserPermisstion WHERE MenuID IN ( SELECT  COALESCE(MenuID,'') FROM  WA_Menu  WHERE  COALESCE(FormName,'')  = '' )

DELETE FROM WA_UserPermisstion WHERE UserName NOT  IN ( SELECT  UserName FROM  SY_User )

DELETE FROM WA_UserPermisstion WHERE MenuID NOT  IN ( SELECT  MenuID FROM  WA_Menu )


INSERT INTO WA_UserPermisstion (  UserName , MenuID , IsRun , IsAdd , IsUpdate , IsDelete , isManager , isAdmin  )

SELECT UserName,  MenuID , 0,0,0,0,0,0
FROM (
SELECT UserName,  MenuID
FROM SY_User, WA_Menu
WHERE  COALESCE(FormName,'')  <> ''
) A
	LEFT JOIN  ( SELECT DISTINCT UserName + MenuID AS Key01 FROM WA_UserPermisstion
	) B ON A.UserName +  A.MenuID   = B.Key01

WHERE B.Key01 IS NULL

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[WA_UserLogsReportStp]
@FromDate DATETIME ,
@ToDate DATETIME,
@UserName VARCHAR(50)

AS

 SELECT  UserName, LogDate, FormID, Para, Note, ComputerName
   FROM  dbo.WA_UserLog A
	INNER JOIN dbo.WA_UserLogDetail B ON B.LogID = A.UserAutoID
	 WHERE CAST(LogDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
	AND FormID <> 'System'
	AND ( @UserName = '' OR UserName LIKE  '%' + @UserName + '%' )
	ORDER BY LogDate
